按标题和相邻中英文段落自动分组，请在阅读时核对原文；图片里的文字不会自动识别。

pages.english: This is a dog. It is brown. It has two big eyes. It is on the grass. It says woof, woof.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狗。它是棕色的。它有两只大眼睛。它在草地上。它汪汪叫。

pages.english: This is a pig. It is pink. It has a curly tail. It is in the mud. It says oink, oink.
pages.chinese: 这是一只猪。它是粉色的。它有一条卷尾巴。它在泥里。它哼哼叫。

pages.english: This is a chicken. It is brown. It has a red comb. It is by the barn. It says cluck, cluck.
pages.chinese: 这是一只鸡。它是棕色的。它有一个红鸡冠。它在谷仓旁边。它咯咯叫。

pages.english: This is a goat. It is white. It has two little horns. It stands on the rocks. It says maa, maa.
pages.chinese: 这是一只山羊。它是白色的。它有两只小角。它站在石头上。它咩咩叫。

pages.english: This is a cow. It is black and white. It has a long tail. It is in the field. It says moo, moo.
pages.chinese: 这是一头奶牛。它是黑白花色的。它有一条长尾巴。它在田里。它哞哞叫。

pages.english: This is a duck. It is yellow. It has a flat bill. It is in the pond. It says quack, quack.
pages.chinese: 这是一只鸭子。它是黄色的。它有一张扁扁的嘴。它在池塘里。它嘎嘎叫。

pages.english: This is a sheep. It is grey. It has soft wool. It is on the hill. It says baa, baa.
pages.chinese: 这是一只绵羊。它是灰色的。它有软软的羊毛。它在小山上。它咩咩叫。

pages.english: This is a farm. Many animals live here. Some are big and some are small. We hear many sounds.
pages.chinese: 这是一个农场。很多动物住在这里。有的大，有的小。我们听到很多叫声。

pages.english: Look at the dogs. They go down the road. The little dogs run first. They go fast.
pages.chinese: 看这些小狗。它们在马路上走。小狗跑在最前面。它们走得很快。

pages.english: Look at the pigs. They go down the road. The fat pigs come after. They go slowly.
pages.chinese: 看这些猪。它们在马路上走。胖胖的猪跟在后面。它们走得很慢。

pages.english: Look at the birds. They go up in the sky. They fly very high. They go together.
pages.chinese: 看这些小鸟。它们飞上天空。它们飞得很高。它们一起走。

pages.english: Look at the cats. They go down the road. The cats hop along. They go quietly.
pages.chinese: 看这些猫。它们在马路上走。猫一跳一跳地走。它们走得很安静。

pages.english: Look at the goats. They go over the hill. They jump as they walk. They go happily.
pages.chinese: 看这些山羊。它们翻过小山。它们边走边跳。它们走得很开心。

pages.english: Look at the cows. They go across the field. They take big heavy steps. They go one by one.
pages.chinese: 看这些牛。它们穿过田野。它们的步子又大又重。它们一个跟着一个。

pages.english: Look at the ducks. They go into the pond. They walk in a line. They go in a row.
pages.chinese: 看这些鸭子。它们走进池塘。它们排成一行。它们一个接一个。

pages.english: Look at all the animals. They all go together. Everybody moves forward. They go on the same road.
pages.chinese: 看所有的动物。它们一起走。大家都往前走。它们走在同一条路上。

pages.english: Look at the cat. It jumps over the stone. It bends down low. It jumps high in the air.
pages.chinese: 看这只猫。它跳过石头。它先蹲得很低。它跳得很高。

pages.english: This is a horse. It jumps over the stone. It has four long legs. It kicks off the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是一匹马。它跳过石头。它有四条长腿。它用力蹬地。

pages.english: This is a deer. It jumps over the stone. It is light and soft. It lands very softly.
pages.chinese: 这是一只鹿。它跳过石头。它又轻又软。它轻轻落地。

pages.english: This is a girl. She jumps over the stone. She lifts her knees. She laughs as she jumps.
pages.chinese: 这是一个小女孩。她跳过石头。她抬起膝盖。她跳的时候在笑。

pages.english: This is a dog. It jumps over the stone. It has four little paws. It barks as it jumps.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狗。它跳过石头。它有四只小爪子。它跳的时候叫。

pages.english: This is a fox. It jumps over the stone. It has a big bushy tail. The tail helps it balance.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狐狸。它跳过石头。它有一条大蓬尾巴。尾巴帮它保持平衡。

pages.english: This is a goat. It jumps over the stone. It bounces like a ball. It jumps again and again.
pages.chinese: 这是一只山羊。它跳过石头。它像球一样弹起来。它一遍又一遍地跳。

pages.english: This is a big cow. It jumps over the stone. It is very heavy. It lands with a big thump.
pages.chinese: 这是一头大奶牛。它跳过石头。它非常重。它落地时咚的一声。

pages.english: This is a cat. It is grey. It has soft whiskers. It is on the sofa. It says meow, meow.
pages.chinese: 这是一只猫。它是灰色的。它有软软的胡须。它在沙发上。它喵喵叫。

pages.english: This is a dog. It is brown. It has a wagging tail. It is by the door. It says woof, woof.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狗。它是棕色的。它在摇尾巴。它在门边。它汪汪叫。

pages.english: This is a bunny. It is white. It has two long ears. It is on the rug. It says squeak, squeak.
pages.chinese: 这是一只兔子。它是白色的。它有两只长耳朵。它在地毯上。它吱吱叫。

pages.english: This is a bird. It is yellow. It has two small wings. It is in its cage. It says tweet, tweet.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小鸟。它是黄色的。它有两个小翅膀。它在笼子里。它啾啾叫。

pages.english: This is a goldfish. It is orange. It has a round shiny body. It is in the water. It goes blub, blub.
pages.chinese: 这是一条金鱼。它是橙色的。它有一个圆圆亮亮的身体。它在水里。它咕噜咕噜吐泡泡。

pages.english: This is a mouse. It is grey. It has two round ears. It is under the chair. It says squeak, squeak.
pages.chinese: 这是一只老鼠。它是灰色的。它有两只圆耳朵。它在椅子下面。它吱吱叫。

pages.english: This is a turtle. It is green. It has a hard shell. It is on the floor. It walks very slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是一只乌龟。它是绿色的。它有一个硬硬的壳。它在地板上。它走得很慢。

pages.english: This is a hamster. It is brown. It has two full cheeks. It is in its nest. It says squeak, squeak.
pages.chinese: 这是一只仓鼠。它是棕色的。它的两颊鼓鼓的。它在窝里。它吱吱叫。

pages.english: This is a fox. It is red. It has a bushy tail. It is in the tall grass. It says yip, yip.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狐狸。它是红色的。它有一条蓬松的尾巴。它在高高的草丛里。它尖尖地叫。

pages.english: This is a giraffe. It is yellow. It has a very long neck. It stands by the tall tree.
pages.chinese: 这是一只长颈鹿。它是黄色的。它的脖子非常长。它站在高树旁边。

pages.english: This is a zebra. It is black and white. It has stripes all over. It is on the wide plain.
pages.chinese: 这是一只斑马。它是黑白色的。它全身都是条纹。它在宽阔的草原上。

pages.english: This is a crocodile. It is green. It has a long snout. It is near the water.
pages.chinese: 这是一条鳄鱼。它是绿色的。它有一个长嘴巴。它在水边。

pages.english: This is an elephant. It is grey. It has a long trunk. It is in the dry grass. It makes a toot, toot.
pages.chinese: 这是一头大象。它是灰色的。它有一个长鼻子。它在干草丛里。它呜呜地叫。

pages.english: This is a lion. It is golden. It has a big mane. It sits in the sun. It says roar, roar.
pages.chinese: 这是一头狮子。它是金黄色的。它有一圈大鬃毛。它坐在阳光下。它吼叫。

pages.english: This is an ostrich. It is brown. It has two long legs. It walks on the open plain.
pages.chinese: 这是一只鸵鸟。它是棕色的。它有两条很长的腿。它在开阔的草原上走。

pages.english: This is the plains. The grass is wide and green. The sky is very big. Many animals live here.
pages.chinese: 这是大草原。草地又宽又绿。天空很大。很多动物住在这里。

pages.english: This is a wild cat. It is spotted. It has sharp little claws. It sits on a thick branch.
pages.chinese: 这是一只野猫。它身上有斑点。它有小而尖的爪子。它坐在粗树枝上。

pages.english: This is a frog. It is green. It has long back legs. It sits on a wet leaf. It says ribbit, ribbit.
pages.chinese: 这是一只青蛙。它是绿色的。它有长长的后腿。它坐在湿叶子上。它呱呱叫。

pages.english: This is a snake. It is green. It has a smooth shiny body. It moves in the wet grass. It says hiss, hiss.
pages.chinese: 这是一条蛇。它是绿色的。它的身体又滑又亮。它在湿草里爬。它嘶嘶地叫。

pages.english: This is a beetle. It is black. It has a hard round shell. It is on the fallen log.
pages.chinese: 这是一只甲虫。它是黑色的。它有一个硬硬的圆壳。它在一根倒下的木头上。

pages.english: This is a monkey. It is brown. It has a long curly tail. It is up in the tree. It says chatter, chatter.
pages.chinese: 这是一只猴子。它是棕色的。它有一条长卷尾巴。它在树上。它叽叽喳喳叫。

pages.english: This is a parrot. It is green. It has a strong curved beak. It sits on the branch.
pages.chinese: 这是一只鹦鹉。它是绿色的。它有一个弯弯的硬嘴。它站在树枝上。

pages.english: This is a butterfly. It is blue. It has two big thin wings. It rests on a flower.
pages.chinese: 这是一只蝴蝶。它是蓝色的。它有两只又大又薄的翅膀。它停在花上。

pages.english: This is the rainforest. The trees are tall and wet. Everything is green. Many animals live here.
pages.chinese: 这是雨林。树又高又湿。到处都是绿色。很多动物住在这里。

pages.english: This is the ocean. The water is deep blue. It has big rolling waves. It is behind the beach.
pages.chinese: 这是大海。海水是深蓝色的。它有翻滚的大浪。它在沙滩的后面。

pages.english: This is the beach. The sand is golden. It is soft and warm. It is beside the water.
pages.chinese: 这是沙滩。沙子是金黄色的。它又软又暖。它在水边。

pages.english: This is a cliff. It is grey rock. It is very steep and high. It stands above the sea.
pages.chinese: 这是悬崖。它是灰色的岩石。它又陡又高。它立在大海上方。

pages.english: This is a lighthouse. It is white. It has a bright lamp on top. It helps the ships at night.
pages.chinese: 这是灯塔。它是白色的。它顶上有一盏亮灯。它在夜里帮船只指路。

pages.english: These are waves. They are white on top. They roll onto the shore. They make a big sound.
pages.chinese: 这些是海浪。它们的顶端是白色的。它们卷到岸边。它们声音很大。

pages.english: These are rocks. They are grey and rough. They sit at the shore. We can stack them up.
pages.chinese: 这些是岩石。它们又灰又粗糙。它们在岸边。我们可以把它们堆起来。

pages.english: These are birds. They are white. They have long thin wings. They fly over the waves.
pages.chinese: 这些是小鸟。它们是白色的。它们有细长的翅膀。它们在海浪上方飞。

pages.english: This is the coast. It has sand, rocks and sea. The sun is warm here. We walk along it.
pages.chinese: 这是海岸。这里有沙子、岩石和海。这里的太阳很暖。我们沿着海岸走。

pages.english: This is water. It is clear. It has no shape of its own. It is in my cup.
pages.chinese: 这是水。它是透明的。它自己没有固定形状。它在我杯子里。

pages.english: This is a lake. The water is calm and blue. It is smooth like glass. It is in the park.
pages.chinese: 这是湖。水面平静，蓝蓝的。它平滑得像玻璃。它在公园里。

pages.english: This is rain. The drops are tiny and silver. They fall from the grey sky. We jump in the rain.
pages.chinese: 这是雨。雨点又小又亮。它们从灰色的天上落下来。我们在雨里跳。

pages.english: This is ice. It is hard and cold. It is clear like glass. It is in the freezer.
pages.chinese: 这是冰。它又硬又冷。它像玻璃一样透明。它在冰箱冷冻室里。

pages.english: This is the ocean. It is deep blue. It is huge and wide. Fish swim in it.
pages.chinese: 这是大海。它是深蓝色的。它又大又宽。鱼在里面游。

pages.english: This is a river. The water runs along. It goes between the hills. We skip stones here.
pages.chinese: 这是河流。水一直往前流。它在山之间流过。我们在这里打水漂。

pages.english: This is snow. It is white and soft. The flakes are very small. It lies on the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是雪。它又白又软。雪片很小。它铺在地上。

pages.english: This is water again. Water can be many things. It can be rain, ice or snow. We use it every day.
pages.chinese: 这又是水。水可以变成很多样子。它可以变成雨、冰或雪。我们每天都用它。

pages.english: This is a ball. It is red. It is round and smooth. It is on the grass.
pages.chinese: 这是一个球。它是红色的。它又圆又滑。它在草地上。

pages.english: These are birds. They are yellow. They have soft little feathers. They sing in the warm sky.
pages.chinese: 这些是小鸟。它们是黄色的。它们有软软的羽毛。它们在暖天上唱歌。

pages.english: This is spring rain. The drops are light and thin. They fall on the leaves. We listen to the sound.
pages.chinese: 这是春雨。雨点又轻又细。它们落在叶子上。我们听雨的声音。

pages.english: This is a bunny. It is white. It has two long ears. It hops on the lawn.
pages.chinese: 这是一只兔子。它是白色的。它有两只长耳朵。它在草地上跳。

pages.english: These are bikes. They are blue. Each one has two wheels. We ride them on the path.
pages.chinese: 这些是自行车。它们是蓝色的。每辆有两个轮子。我们在小路上骑。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are pink. They have soft petals. They grow in the garden.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是粉色的。它们有软软的花瓣。它们长在花园里。

pages.english: This is a rainbow. It has many colours. It makes a wide curve. It is across the sky.
pages.chinese: 这是彩虹。它有很多颜色。它弯成一道宽宽的弧。它横跨天空。

pages.english: This is spring. There are flowers and rain. The birds come back. We play outside.
pages.chinese: 这是春天。这里有花，也有雨。小鸟回来了。我们在外面玩。

pages.english: This is sunshine. It is golden and bright. It is warm on my skin. It comes from the sky.
pages.chinese: 这是阳光。它金灿灿的，很亮。照在皮肤上暖暖的。它从天上照下来。

pages.english: This is the beach. The sand is golden. It is soft and hot. We build castles here.
pages.chinese: 这是沙滩。沙子是金黄色的。它又软又热。我们在这里堆城堡。

pages.english: This is a ball. It is blue. It is light and bouncy. It is on the sand.
pages.chinese: 这是一个球。它是蓝色的。它又轻又有弹性。它在沙子上。

pages.english: This is a garden. It is full of green plants. The plants have big leaves. It is behind the house.
pages.chinese: 这是一个花园。里面全是绿绿的植物。植物的叶子很大。它在房子后面。

pages.english: This is summer rain. The drops are big and quick. They come from a dark cloud. We splash in the puddles.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的雨。雨点又大又急。它们从乌云里落下来。我们在水洼里踩水。

pages.english: This is a swimsuit. It is pink. It is soft and stretchy. I wear it to swim.
pages.chinese: 这是一件泳衣。它是粉色的。它又软又有弹性。我穿它去游泳。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are red. Their petals are wide and bright. They grow in the sun.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是红色的。花瓣又宽又亮。它们在太阳下开放。

pages.english: This is summer. There is sun and sand. We swim and play all day. Summer is full of fun.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天。这里有太阳和沙子。我们整天游泳、玩耍。夏天到处都是快乐。

pages.english: This is a leaf. It is red. It is thin and flat. It lies on the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是一片叶子。它是红色的。它又薄又平。它落在地上。

pages.english: This is an acorn. It is brown. It has a tiny little cap. It is under the oak tree.
pages.chinese: 这是一颗橡果。它是棕色的。它顶上有一个小小的帽。它在橡树下面。

pages.english: This is a pumpkin. It is orange. It has a thick hard skin. It grows in the field.
pages.chinese: 这是一个南瓜。它是橙色的。它的皮又厚又硬。它长在田里。

pages.english: This is the moon. It is pale and round. It is high in the night sky. It looks silver in fall.
pages.chinese: 这是月亮。它又白又圆。它挂在夜空高处。秋天的月亮看起来像银子。

pages.english: This is an apple. It is red. It is smooth and shiny. It hangs on the tree.
pages.chinese: 这是一个苹果。它是红色的。它又滑又亮。它挂在树上。

pages.english: This is corn. It is yellow. It has lots of little kernels. It grows in the field.
pages.chinese: 这是玉米。它是黄色的。它有很多小颗粒。它长在田里。

pages.english: This is a rake. It is made of metal. It has many small teeth. We gather leaves with it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个耙子。它是金属做的。它有很多小齿。我们用它把叶子聚起来。

pages.english: This is a jacket. It is blue. It has long thick sleeves. It hangs on the hook.
pages.chinese: 这是一件夹克。它是蓝色的。它有长长的厚袖子。它挂在钩子上。

pages.english: This is snow. It is white and cold. The flakes are tiny. It covers the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是雪。它又白又冷。雪花很小。它盖住了地面。

pages.english: This is a sled. It is red. It has a smooth flat base. It goes down the snowy hill.
pages.chinese: 这是一个雪橇。它是红色的。它有一块光滑的底板。它从雪坡上滑下去。

pages.english: These are mittens. They are blue. They are soft and thick. They keep my hands warm.
pages.chinese: 这是手套。它们是蓝色的。它们又软又厚。它们让我的手暖和。

pages.english: This is a fire. It is orange. The flames dance up high. It is warm and bright.
pages.chinese: 这是一团火。它是橙色的。火苗高高地跳。它又暖又亮。

pages.english: These are ice skates. They are silver. They have sharp thin blades. We skate on the ice.
pages.chinese: 这是冰鞋。它们是银色的。它们的刀刃又薄又利。我们在冰上滑。

pages.english: This is a snowman. It is white and round. It has two little coal eyes. We build it in the yard.
pages.chinese: 这是一个雪人。它又白又圆。它有两只小黑眼睛。我们在院子里堆它。

pages.english: This is a coat. It is blue. It has a big cosy hood. It hangs by the door.
pages.chinese: 这是一件大衣。它是蓝色的。它有一个大大的帽子。它挂在门边。

pages.english: This is winter. There is snow and ice. The wind is cold. We stay cosy inside.
pages.chinese: 这是冬天。这里有雪，也有冰。风很冷。我们在屋里待得暖暖的。

pages.english: This is the sea. The water is blue. The waves are small and gentle. The sky is above it.
pages.chinese: 这是海。海水是蓝色的。浪又小又轻。天空在它上方。

pages.english: This is coral. It has many colours. It has twisty hard branches. It grows deep on the reef.
pages.chinese: 这是珊瑚。它有很多颜色。它的枝杈弯弯的、硬硬的。它长在深深的海礁上。

pages.english: This is a fish. It is orange. It has a wiggly tail. It swims in the sea. It goes blub, blub.
pages.chinese: 这是一条鱼。它是橙色的。它有一条摆动的尾巴。它在海里游。它咕噜咕噜地吐泡泡。

pages.english: This is a starfish. It is orange. It has five soft arms. It rests on a wet rock.
pages.chinese: 这是一只海星。它是橙色的。它有五条软软的腕。它趴在湿石头上。

pages.english: This is sand. It is golden. The grains are tiny and soft. It lies on the sea floor.
pages.chinese: 这是沙子。它是金黄色的。沙粒又小又软。它铺在海底。

pages.english: This is seaweed. It is green. It has long wavy leaves. It sways in the water.
pages.chinese: 这是海草。它是绿色的。它的叶子又长又弯。它在水里摇来摇去。

pages.english: This is a crab. It is red. It has two strong claws. It walks on the sand. It goes click, click.
pages.chinese: 这是一只螃蟹。它是红色的。它有两只大钳子。它在沙子上走。它咔咔地响。

pages.english: This is the ocean. It has fish and coral. It is deep and wide. We can explore it.
pages.chinese: 这是大海。里面有鱼，也有珊瑚。它又深又宽。我们可以去认识它。

pages.english: This is dirt. It is brown and soft. It fills the pot. A plant can grow in it.
pages.chinese: 这是泥土。它又棕又软。它装满花盆。植物能在里面生长。

pages.english: This is a hole. It is small and round. It is deep in the dirt. We put a seed in it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个洞。它又小又圆。它在泥土里很深。我们把种子放进去。

pages.english: This is rain. The drops are cool. They fall on the soil. They give the seed water.
pages.chinese: 这是雨。雨点凉凉的。它们落在泥土上。它们给种子喝水。

pages.english: This is a baby plant. It is green. It has two small leaves. It comes up from the dirt.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵小树苗。它是绿色的。它有两片小叶子。它从土里冒出来。

pages.english: This is a shovel. It is metal. It has a wide flat head. We dig with it.
pages.chinese: 这是一把铲子。它是金属的。它有一个宽宽的铲头。我们用它挖土。

pages.english: This is a seed. It is small and brown. It has a hard little coat. It sleeps under the soil.
pages.chinese: 这是一颗种子。它又小又棕。它有一层硬硬的小壳。它睡在土下面。

pages.english: This is sunshine. It is warm and bright. It comes from the sky. It helps the plant grow.
pages.chinese: 这是阳光。它又暖又亮。它从天上照下来。它帮植物长大。

pages.english: This is a plant. It is green. It has many big leaves. It grows in the garden.
pages.chinese: 这是一株植物。它是绿色的。它有很多大叶子。它长在花园里。

pages.english: This is a chicken. It is brown. It has a small round body. It lives on the farm. It says cluck, cluck.
pages.chinese: 这是一只鸡。它是棕色的。它的身体又小又圆。它住在农场。它咯咯叫。

pages.english: These are feathers. They are soft and brown. They lie in thin layers. They keep the chicken warm.
pages.chinese: 这些是羽毛。它们又软又棕。它们一层一层地盖着。它们让鸡暖和。

pages.english: This is the tail. It is short. It looks like a little fan. It sits at the back.
pages.chinese: 这是尾巴。它短短的。它像一把小扇子。它长在身后。

pages.english: These are the feet. They are yellow. Each foot has three toes. They scratch the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是它的脚。它们是黄色的。每只脚有三个脚趾。它们在地上刨土。

pages.english: This is the beak. It is yellow and hard. It has a sharp point. It picks up seeds.
pages.chinese: 这是它的嘴。它又黄又硬。它有一个尖尖的头。它用来啄种子。

pages.english: These are the wings. They are brown. They are small and short. It flaps them up and down.
pages.chinese: 这是它的翅膀。它们是棕色的。它们又小又短。它把翅膀上下扑动。

pages.english: These are the legs. They are thin and yellow. They carry the chicken along. They walk very fast.
pages.chinese: 这是它的腿。它们又细又黄。它们带着鸡走路。它们走得很快。

pages.english: These are eggs. They are white. They are smooth and round. They lie in the nest.
pages.chinese: 这些是鸡蛋。它们是白色的。它们又滑又圆。它们躺在窝里。

pages.english: These are doves. They are soft grey. They have small round bodies. They sit on the roof. They say coo, coo.
pages.chinese: 这些是鸽子。它们是柔柔的灰色。它们的身体又小又圆。它们坐在屋顶上。它们咕咕叫。

pages.english: These are crows. They are shiny black. They have strong thick beaks. They sit in the tall tree. They say caw, caw.
pages.chinese: 这些是乌鸦。它们是黑亮亮的。它们的嘴又粗又硬。它们待在大树上。它们啊啊地叫。

pages.english: These are eagles. They are brown. They have huge wide wings. They fly above the hill.
pages.chinese: 这些是老鹰。它们是棕色的。它们的翅膀又大又宽。它们在山的上空飞。

pages.english: These are turkeys. They are brown. They have fan-shaped tails. They live on the farm. They say gobble, gobble.
pages.chinese: 这些是火鸡。它们是棕色的。它们的尾巴像扇子。它们住在农场。它们咯咯地叫。

pages.english: These are hawks. They are brown. They have sharp bright eyes. They fly high in the sky.
pages.chinese: 这些是鹰。它们是棕色的。它们的眼睛又亮又尖。它们在高高的天上飞。

pages.english: These are owls. They are brown. They have big round eyes. They live in the tree hole. They say hoot, hoot.
pages.chinese: 这些是猫头鹰。它们是棕色的。它们的眼睛又大又圆。它们住在树洞里。它们呜呜地叫。

pages.english: These are geese. They are white. They have long necks. They swim on the pond. They say honk, honk.
pages.chinese: 这些是鹅。它们是白色的。它们的脖子很长。它们在池塘里游。它们嘎嘎地叫。

pages.english: These are birds. They have wings and beaks. They come in many colours. We hear their songs.
pages.chinese: 这些是鸟。它们有翅膀，也有嘴。它们的颜色很多。我们听到它们的歌声。

pages.english: The rain falls on the fairies. The fairies are very little. They have soft round wings. They dance in the rain.
pages.chinese: 雨落在仙女身上。仙女很小很小。她们有软软的圆翅膀。她们在雨里跳舞。

pages.english: The rain falls on the bugs. The bugs are tiny. They have thin little legs. They hide under the big leaves.
pages.chinese: 雨落在虫子身上。虫子很小。它们的腿又细又小。它们躲在大叶子下面。

pages.english: The rain falls on the rocks. The rocks are grey. Their faces are rough and hard. The rain makes them wet.
pages.chinese: 雨落在石头上。石头是灰色的。它们的表面又粗又硬。雨把它们打湿了。

pages.english: The rain falls on the water. The water is calm. The drops make small circles. They spread out wide.
pages.chinese: 雨落在水里。水面很平静。雨点打出一圈圈小圆。圆圈慢慢散开。

pages.english: The rain falls on the flowers. The flowers are bright. Their petals are open. They drink the rain.
pages.chinese: 雨落在花上。花儿很鲜艳。花瓣都开着。它们喝雨水。

pages.english: The rain falls on the leaves. The leaves are green. They are wide and smooth. They hold the drops.
pages.chinese: 雨落在叶子上。叶子是绿色的。它们又宽又滑。它们接住雨点。

pages.english: The rain falls on the animals. They have soft fur coats. They live in the woods. They run for shelter.
pages.chinese: 雨落在动物身上。它们有软软的毛。它们住在树林里。它们跑去躲雨。

pages.english: The rain falls on the roofs. The roofs are wet and shiny. They are above the house. The drops go tap, tap.
pages.chinese: 雨落在屋顶上。屋顶又湿又亮。它们在房子上方。雨点咚咚地敲。

pages.english: These are bats. They are brown. They have thin wings. They hang upside down in a tree. They say squeak, squeak.
pages.chinese: 这些是蝙蝠。它们是棕色的。它们的翅膀很薄。它们倒挂在树上。它们吱吱叫。

pages.english: These are monkeys. They are brown. They have long curly tails. They sit up in the branches. They say chatter, chatter.
pages.chinese: 这些是猴子。它们是棕色的。它们有长长的卷尾巴。它们坐在树枝上。它们叽叽喳喳。

pages.english: These are tigers. They are orange. They have black stripes. They hide in the thick grass. They say roar, roar.
pages.chinese: 这些是老虎。它们是橙色的。它们有黑色的条纹。它们藏在密草里。它们吼叫。

pages.english: These are ants. They are black. They have six thin legs. They walk on the jungle floor.
pages.chinese: 这些是蚂蚁。它们是黑色的。它们有六条细腿。它们走在丛林地面上。

pages.english: These are birds. They are colourful. They have bright soft feathers. They fly above the trees. They say chirp, chirp.
pages.chinese: 这些是小鸟。它们五颜六色。它们的羽毛又亮又软。它们飞过树顶。它们啾啾叫。

pages.english: These are frogs. They are green. They have strong back legs. They sit by the stream. They say ribbit, ribbit.
pages.chinese: 这些是青蛙。它们是绿色的。它们的后腿很有力。它们坐在小溪边。它们呱呱叫。

pages.english: These are snakes. They are green. They have smooth long bodies. They move in the wet grass. They say hiss, hiss.
pages.chinese: 这些是蛇。它们是绿色的。它们的身体又滑又长。它们在湿草里爬。它们嘶嘶叫。

pages.english: This is the jungle. The trees are tall and wet. Many animals live here. They are all friends.
pages.chinese: 这是丛林。树又高又湿。很多动物住在这里。它们都是朋友。

pages.english: This is a dog. It is brown. It has two sleepy eyes. It naps on the soft rug.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狗。它是棕色的。它的眼睛困困的。它在软软的地毯上睡。

pages.english: This is a horse. It is brown. It has four long legs. It naps standing up.
pages.chinese: 这是一匹马。它是棕色的。它有四条长腿。它站着睡觉。

pages.english: This is a lizard. It is green. It has a long wiggly tail. It naps on the warm rock.
pages.chinese: 这是一只蜥蜴。它是绿色的。它有一条摆来摆去的长尾巴。它在暖石头上睡。

pages.english: This is a giraffe. It is spotted. It has a very long neck. It naps in the tree shade.
pages.chinese: 这是一只长颈鹿。它身上有斑点。它的脖子非常长。它在树荫里睡。

pages.english: This is a bat. It is brown. It has thin folded wings. It naps upside down all day.
pages.chinese: 这是一只蝙蝠。它是棕色的。它的薄翅膀收起来了。它整天倒挂着睡。

pages.english: This is a bird. It is yellow. It has a round little head. It naps with its head tucked.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小鸟。它是黄色的。它有一个圆圆的小脑袋。它把头缩起来睡。

pages.english: This is a fish. It is orange. It has a slow soft tail. It naps in the calm water.
pages.chinese: 这是一条鱼。它是橙色的。它的尾巴慢慢地摆。它在平静的水里睡。

pages.english: This is a baby. It is little and warm. It has two soft cheeks. It naps in the warm bed.
pages.chinese: 这是一个小宝宝。它又小又暖。它有两个软软的脸蛋。它在暖暖的床上睡。

pages.english: This is a red egg. It has a smooth round shell. It sits on the table. I hold it in my hand.
pages.chinese: 这是一个红色的蛋。它的壳又滑又圆。它放在桌上。我把它拿在手里。

pages.english: This is a pink egg. Its shell is soft and shiny. It lies on the mat. I look at it closely.
pages.chinese: 这是一个粉色的蛋。它的壳又软又亮。它放在垫子上。我仔细看它。

pages.english: This is an orange egg. The shell is smooth and oval. It sits in the basket. I put it in.
pages.chinese: 这是一个橙色的蛋。壳又滑又椭圆。它在篮子里。我把它放进去。

pages.english: This is a blue egg. Its shell is cool and smooth. It is next to the cup. I roll it along.
pages.chinese: 这是一个蓝色的蛋。它的壳凉凉滑滑。它在杯子旁边。我让它滚一滚。

pages.english: This is a yellow egg. The shell is bright and round. It is on the floor. I hide it for you.
pages.chinese: 这是一个黄色的蛋。壳又亮又圆。它在地上。我把它藏起来。

pages.english: This is a purple egg. Its shell is deep and dark. It sits by the box. I collect it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个紫色的蛋。它的壳颜色很深。它在盒子旁边。我把它收起来。

pages.english: This is a green egg. The shell is fresh and cool. It is on the shelf. I count it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个绿色的蛋。壳清清凉凉。它在架子上。我数一数它。

pages.english: This is a colourful egg. It has spots of many colours. It is in our hands. We hunt for it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个彩色的蛋。它上面的斑点有很多颜色。它在我们手里。我们找它。

pages.english: This is a shirt. It is purple. It has two short sleeves. It lies on the chair.
pages.chinese: 这是一件短袖。它是紫色的。它有两个短袖子。它放在椅子上。

pages.english: These are flip-flops. They are purple. They have flat soft soles. They are on the floor.
pages.chinese: 这是人字拖。它们是紫色的。它们的鞋底又平又软。它们在地上。

pages.english: This is a towel. It is purple. It has a soft fluffy edge. It hangs on the hook.
pages.chinese: 这是一条毛巾。它是紫色的。它的边软软的毛茸茸的。它挂在钩子上。

pages.english: This is a bucket. It is purple. It has one curved handle. It sits on the sand.
pages.chinese: 这是一个桶。它是紫色的。它有一个弯弯的提手。它放在沙子上。

pages.english: This is a hat. It is purple. It has a wide round brim. I put it on my head.
pages.chinese: 这是一顶帽子。它是紫色的。它有一个宽宽的圆帽檐。我把它戴在头上。

pages.english: This is a ball. It is purple. It is round and smooth. It is on the grass.
pages.chinese: 这是一个球。它是紫色的。它又圆又滑。它在草地上。

pages.english: This is a backpack. It is purple. It has two long straps. It is by the door.
pages.chinese: 这是一个背包。它是紫色的。它有两条长背带。它在门边。

pages.english: This is an ice pop. It is purple. It has one thin stick. I lick it slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是一根冰棍。它是紫色的。它有一根细细的棍。我慢慢舔它。

pages.english: This is a bus. It is yellow. It has four black wheels. It goes on the road.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆巴士。它是黄色的。它有四个黑轮子。它在马路上开。

pages.english: This is a cab. It is yellow. It has four spinning wheels. It waits in the street.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆出租车。它是黄色的。它的四个轮子会转。它在街上等客人。

pages.english: This is a truck. It is yellow. It has a wide long bed. It carries goods.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆卡车。它是黄色的。它有一个又宽又长的车斗。它运货物。

pages.english: These are lines. They are yellow. They are long and straight. They lie on the dark road.
pages.chinese: 这些是线。它们是黄色的。它们又长又直。它们画在深色的路上。

pages.english: This is a light. It is yellow. It has a round cover. It glows above the street.
pages.chinese: 这是一盏灯。它是黄色的。它有一个圆圆的罩。它在大街上亮着。

pages.english: These are signs. They are yellow. They have clear black words. They stand by the road.
pages.chinese: 这些是标志。它们是黄色的。上面有清楚的黑字。它们立在路边。

pages.english: This is a vest. It is yellow. It is loose and comfy. The worker wears it.
pages.chinese: 这是一件背心。它是黄色的。它又宽松又舒服。工人穿着它。

pages.english: This is a hat. It is yellow. It has a wide brim. It keeps the sun off.
pages.chinese: 这是一顶帽子。它是黄色的。它有一个宽宽的帽檐。它挡住太阳。

pages.english: This is the sky. It is blue. Soft white clouds float in it. It is high above us.
pages.chinese: 这是天空。它是蓝色的。软软的白云飘在里面。它在我们头顶很高处。

pages.english: This is a bike. It is blue. It has two big wheels. I ride it on the path.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆自行车。它是蓝色的。它有两个大轮子。我在小路上骑它。

pages.english: This is a bench. It is blue. It has a flat wide seat. It stands under the tree.
pages.chinese: 这是一条长椅。它是蓝色的。它的座位又平又宽。它立在大树下。

pages.english: This is a slide. It is blue. It has a smooth long slope. Children slide down it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个滑梯。它是蓝色的。它有一道又长又滑的坡。孩子们从上面滑下来。

pages.english: This is a helmet. It is blue. It has a hard round top. I wear it on my head.
pages.chinese: 这是一个头盔。它是蓝色的。它有一个硬硬的圆顶。我把它戴在头上。

pages.english: This is a bottle. It is blue. It has a small round cap. It sits on the bench.
pages.chinese: 这是一个水杯。它是蓝色的。它有一个小小的圆盖。它放在长椅上。

pages.english: This is a swing. It is blue. It has two long ropes. It hangs under the bar.
pages.chinese: 这是秋千。它是蓝色的。它有两根长绳。它挂在横杆下面。

pages.english: This is the playground. Everything here is blue. There are slides and swings. It is behind the school.
pages.chinese: 这是操场。这里的东西都是蓝色的。这里有滑梯，也有秋千。它在学校后面。

pages.english: This is a snake. It is green. It has a smooth long body. It moves in the grass. It says hiss, hiss.
pages.chinese: 这是一条蛇。它是绿色的。它的身体又滑又长。它在草里爬。它嘶嘶叫。

pages.english: This is moss. It is green. It grows in tiny soft strands. It covers the wet rock.
pages.chinese: 这是苔藓。它是绿色的。它长成一簇簇细细的软丝。它盖住了湿石头。

pages.english: This is a bird. It is green. It has two thin wings. It hides in the bush. It says chirp, chirp.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小鸟。它是绿色的。它有两个薄薄的翅膀。它藏在灌木里。它啾啾叫。

pages.english: This is a lizard. It is green. It has a long wiggly tail. It sits on the warm stone.
pages.chinese: 这是一只蜥蜴。它是绿色的。它有一条摆来摆去的长尾巴。它在暖石头上。

pages.english: This is a leaf. It is green. It has small thin veins. It grows on the branch.
pages.chinese: 这是一片叶子。它是绿色的。上面有细细的叶脉。它长在树枝上。

pages.english: This is a frog. It is green. It has strong back legs. It sits on the lily pad. It says ribbit, ribbit.
pages.chinese: 这是一只青蛙。它是绿色的。它的后腿很有力。它坐在荷叶上。它呱呱叫。

pages.english: This is an insect. It is green. It has six tiny legs. It climbs the stem.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小虫。它是绿色的。它有六条小细腿。它爬上花茎。

pages.english: This is the rainforest. Everything here is green. The trees are tall and wet. It is full of life.
pages.chinese: 这是雨林。这里到处都是绿色。树又高又湿。这里生机勃勃。

pages.english: This is a tree. Its leaves are orange. It has twisty brown branches. It stands in the field.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵树。它的叶子是橙色的。它有弯弯的棕色树枝。它立在田野里。

pages.english: This is a pumpkin. It is orange. It is big and round. It sits in the field.
pages.chinese: 这是一个南瓜。它是橙色的。它又大又圆。它在地里。

pages.english: This is a butterfly. It is orange. It has two thin wings. It rests on a flower.
pages.chinese: 这是一只蝴蝶。它是橙色的。它有两片薄薄的翅膀。它停在一朵花上。

pages.english: This is the field. Everything is orange now. The grass is dry and gold. It goes on for miles.
pages.chinese: 这是田野。现在到处是橙色。草又干又金。它一直延伸到很远。

pages.english: This is a leaf. It is orange. It is thin and curly. It falls from the tree.
pages.chinese: 这是一片叶子。它是橙色的。它又薄又卷。它从树上落下。

pages.english: This is a flower. It is orange. Its petals are wide open. It grows in the garden.
pages.chinese: 这是一朵花。它是橙色的。它的花瓣都张开了。它长在花园里。

pages.english: This is a snake. It is orange. It has a long thin body. It slides over the sand.
pages.chinese: 这是一条蛇。它是橙色的。它的身体又长又细。它在沙子上滑过。

pages.english: This is the sunset. The sky turns orange. The sun goes down low. The day is over.
pages.chinese: 这是日落。天空变成橙色。太阳慢慢落下。一天结束了。

pages.english: This is a tomato. It is red. Its skin is smooth and shiny. It hangs on the vine.
pages.chinese: 这是一个番茄。它是红色的。它的皮又滑又亮。它挂在藤上。

pages.english: This is a cherry. It is red. It has a thin little stem. It grows on the tree.
pages.chinese: 这是一颗樱桃。它是红色的。它有一根细细的小梗。它长在树上。

pages.english: This is an apple. It is red. It is round and glossy. It hangs on the branch.
pages.chinese: 这是一个苹果。它是红色的。它又圆又亮。它挂在树枝上。

pages.english: This is a potato. Its skin is red. It is firm and rough. It hides under the dirt.
pages.chinese: 这是一个土豆。它的皮是红色的。它又结实又粗糙。它藏在土下面。

pages.english: This is a beet. It is red. It is round and deep. It grows in the garden.
pages.chinese: 这是一个甜菜。它是红色的。它又圆又深。它长在花园里。

pages.english: This is a strawberry. It is red. It has tiny little seeds. It grows low on the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是一颗草莓。它是红色的。它上面有很多小种子。它长得很矮，贴近地面。

pages.english: This is a pepper. It is red. It is long and thick. It hangs on the plant.
pages.chinese: 这是一个辣椒。它是红色的。它又长又厚。它挂在植株上。

pages.english: This is a radish. It is red. It has thin green tops. We pull it out.
pages.chinese: 这是一个萝卜。它是红色的。它有细细的绿叶子。我们把它拔出来。

pages.english: This is snow. It is white. The flakes are tiny and soft. It covers the ground. We play in it.
pages.chinese: 这是雪。它是白色的。雪花又小又软。它盖住了地面。我们在雪里玩。

pages.english: This is a fox. It is white. It has thick fur. It stands on the ice. It says yip, yip.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狐狸。它是白色的。它有厚厚的毛。它站在冰上。它尖尖地叫。

pages.english: This is a seal. It is white. It has a smooth round body. It rests on the ice.
pages.chinese: 这是一只海豹。它是白色的。它的身体又滑又圆。它趴在冰上。

pages.english: This is an owl. It is white. It has two big round eyes. It sits in the bare tree. It says hoot, hoot.
pages.chinese: 这是一只猫头鹰。它是白色的。它有两只圆圆的大眼睛。它待在光秃秃的树上。它呜呜地叫。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are white. Their petals are small and soft. They grow in the green grass.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是白色的。花瓣又小又软。它们长在绿草里。

pages.english: This is a whale. It is white. It has a huge wide tail. It swims deep in the sea.
pages.chinese: 这是一头鲸。它是白色的。它有一个又大又宽的尾巴。它在深海里游。

pages.english: These are eggs. They are white. Their shells are smooth and round. They lie in the warm nest.
pages.chinese: 这些是蛋。它们是白色的。它们的壳又滑又圆。它们躺在暖和的窝里。

pages.english: This is an igloo. It is white. It is round like a ball. It is made of snow.
pages.chinese: 这是一座雪屋。它是白色的。它圆圆的像个球。它是雪做的。

pages.english: This is a stage. It is black. The floor is wide and flat. A show is on it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个舞台。它是黑色的。地板又宽又平。上面正在表演。

pages.english: This is a suit. It is black. It is neat and tidy. It hangs on the rack.
pages.chinese: 这是一套西服。它是黑色的。它又整齐又挺括。它挂在衣架上。

pages.english: This is a cape. It is black. It is long and flowing. It is on his shoulders.
pages.chinese: 这是一件披风。它是黑色的。它又长又会飘。它披在他肩上。

pages.english: This is a wand. It is black. It has one thin pointed tip. He holds it in his hand.
pages.chinese: 这是一根魔杖。它是黑色的。它有一个细细的尖。他把它拿在手里。

pages.english: This is a sheet. It is black. It is flat and smooth. Things hide under it.
pages.chinese: 这是一块布。它是黑色的。它又平又滑。东西藏在它下面。

pages.english: This is a tie. It is black. It is long and narrow. It hangs around his neck.
pages.chinese: 这是一条领带。它是黑色的。它又长又窄。它挂在他脖子上。

pages.english: This is a hat. It is black. It has a tall round top. He wears it on his head.
pages.chinese: 这是一顶帽子。它是黑色的。它有一个高高的圆顶。他戴在头上。

pages.english: This is a rabbit. It is black. It has two long ears. It sits in the tall hat.
pages.chinese: 这是一只兔子。它是黑色的。它有两只长耳朵。它待在高帽子里。

pages.english: This is one bed. It is soft and big. It is in my room. There is only one.
pages.chinese: 这是一张床。它又软又大。它在我房间。只有一张。

pages.english: This is one window. It is clear and bright. It is in the wall. Light comes in.
pages.chinese: 这是一扇窗户。它又干净又明亮。它镶在墙里。光从这里照进来。

pages.english: This is one toy. It is little and round. It is on the rug. I play with it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个玩具。它又小又圆。它在地毯上。我和它玩。

pages.english: This is one rug. It is soft and warm. It is on the floor. It is cosy under my feet.
pages.chinese: 这是一块地毯。它又软又暖。它铺在地上。踩在脚下暖暖的。

pages.english: This is one pillow. It is white and fluffy. It is on my bed. I put my head on it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个枕头。它又白又软。它在我的床上。我把头放上去。

pages.english: This is one book. It is thin and light. It is on the desk. We read it together.
pages.chinese: 这是一本书。它又薄又轻。它在书桌上。我们一起读它。

pages.english: This is one blanket. It is thick and warm. It is on the bed. It keeps me warm.
pages.chinese: 这是一条毯子。它又厚又暖。它在床上。它让我暖和。

pages.english: This is one desk. It is made of wood. It stands by the wall. I work here.
pages.chinese: 这是一张桌子。它是木头做的。它靠墙放着。我在这里做事。

pages.english: Here are two bees. They are small and striped. They sit on the flowers. They go buzz, buzz.
pages.chinese: 这里有两只蜜蜂。它们又小又有条纹。它们停在花上。它们嗡嗡叫。

pages.english: Here are two birds. They are soft and round. They sit on the branch. They go tweet, tweet.
pages.chinese: 这里有两只小鸟。它们又软又圆。它们停在树枝上。它们啾啾叫。

pages.english: Here are two dogs. They are brown and fluffy. They run on the lawn. They go woof, woof.
pages.chinese: 这里有两条狗。它们又棕又毛茸茸。它们在草坪上跑。它们汪汪叫。

pages.english: Here are two horses. They are tall and brown. They stand by the fence. They go neigh, neigh.
pages.chinese: 这里有两匹马。它们又高又棕。它们站在篱笆边。它们咴咴叫。

pages.english: Here are two fish. They are orange and small. They swim in the tank. They go blub, blub.
pages.chinese: 这里有两条鱼。它们又橙又小。它们在鱼缸里游。它们咕噜咕噜吐泡泡。

pages.english: Here are two cats. They are grey and quiet. They sit in the sun. They go meow, meow.
pages.chinese: 这里有两只猫。它们又灰又安静。它们坐在太阳下。它们喵喵叫。

pages.english: Here are two cows. They are black and white. They stand in the field. They go moo, moo.
pages.chinese: 这里有两头奶牛。它们是黑白色的。它们站在田里。它们哞哞叫。

pages.english: Here are two kids. They are small and happy. They run on the path. They laugh together.
pages.chinese: 这里有两个小孩。他们又小又开心。他们在小路上跑。他们一起笑。

pages.english: Here are three tigers. They are orange with stripes. They hide in the grass. They go roar, roar.
pages.chinese: 这里有3只老虎。它们是橙色带条纹的。它们藏在草丛里。它们吼叫。

pages.english: Here are three bears. They are big and brown. They sit by the tree. They go growl, growl.
pages.chinese: 这里有3只熊。它们又大又棕。它们坐在树边。它们低吼。

pages.english: Here are three elephants. They are grey and heavy. They stand by the pond. They go toot, toot.
pages.chinese: 这里有3头大象。它们又灰又重。它们站在池塘边。它们呜呜叫。

pages.english: Here are three frogs. They are green and small. They sit on the bank. They go ribbit, ribbit.
pages.chinese: 这里有3只青蛙。它们又绿又小。它们蹲在岸边。它们呱呱叫。

pages.english: Here are three lions. They are golden with manes. They rest in the sun. They go roar, roar.
pages.chinese: 这里有3头狮子。它们是金黄色，有鬃毛。它们在阳光下休息。它们吼叫。

pages.english: Here are three monkeys. They are brown and quick. They climb in the trees. They go chatter, chatter.
pages.chinese: 这里有3只猴子。它们又棕又灵活。它们在树上爬。它们叽叽喳喳。

pages.english: Here are three camels. They are brown with humps. They walk on the dry sand.
pages.chinese: 这里有3只骆驼。它们棕棕色，背上有驼峰。它们在干沙上走。

pages.english: Here are three pandas. They are black and white. They sit on the grass. They eat green leaves.
pages.chinese: 这里有3只大熊猫。它们是黑白色的。它们坐在草地上。它们吃绿叶子。

pages.english: Here are four buses. They are big and yellow. They wait at the station. They go beep, beep.
pages.chinese: 这里有4辆公共汽车。它们又大又黄。它们停在车站。它们嘟嘟叫。

pages.english: Here are four cars. They are small and shiny. They drive on the road.
pages.chinese: 这里有4辆小汽车。它们又小又亮。它们在马路上开。

pages.english: Here are four trucks. They are wide and loud. They carry heavy loads.
pages.chinese: 这里有4辆卡车。它们又宽又响。它们运很重的东西。

pages.english: Here are four airplanes. They are white and big. They fly in the sky.
pages.chinese: 这里有4架飞机。它们又白又大。它们在天上飞。

pages.english: Here are four carts. They are small and wooden. They stand on the farm.
pages.chinese: 这里有4辆手推车。它们又小又是木头做的。它们停在农场里。

pages.english: Here are four wagons. They are light and rolling. They wait in the street.
pages.chinese: 这里有4辆小拖车。它们又轻又能滚。它们在街上等着。

pages.english: Here are four boats. They are white and floating. They rock on the lake.
pages.chinese: 这里有4艘船。它们又白又漂。它们在湖上摇。

pages.english: Here are four vans. They are white and roomy. They park by the building.
pages.chinese: 这里有4辆面包车。它们又白又宽敞。它们停在楼旁。

pages.english: Here are five cups. They are small and round. They stand on the tray. They are empty now.
pages.chinese: 这里有5个杯子。它们又小又圆。它们放在托盘上。现在是空的。

pages.english: Here are five bowls. They are wide and clean. They sit on the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有5个碗。它们又宽又干净。它们放在桌上。

pages.english: Here are five spoons. They are small and silver. They lie by the bowls.
pages.chinese: 这里有5个勺子。它们又小又亮。它们放在碗旁边。

pages.english: Here are five chairs. They are firm and tall. They stand around the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有5把椅子。它们又结实又高。它们围着桌子。

pages.english: Here are five plates. They are white and round. They lie on the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有5个盘子。它们又白又圆。它们放在桌上。

pages.english: Here are five forks. They are small and sharp. They sit on the right side.
pages.chinese: 这里有5个叉子。它们又小又尖。它们放在右边。

pages.english: Here are five pans. They are dark and heavy. They hang on the wall.
pages.chinese: 这里有5个平底锅。它们又黑又重。它们挂在墙上。

pages.english: Here are five lunches. Each has bread and fruit. They are packed in bags. We eat together.
pages.chinese: 这里有5份午餐。每份都有面包和水果。它们装好在袋子里。我们一起吃。

pages.english: Here are six shirts. They are soft and neat. They hang in the closet.
pages.chinese: 这里有6件短袖。它们又软又挺。它们挂在衣橱里。

pages.english: Here are six dresses. They are long and bright. They hang on the rack.
pages.chinese: 这里有6件裙子。它们又长又鲜亮。它们挂在架子上。

pages.english: Here are six socks. They are small and warm. They lie in the drawer.
pages.chinese: 这里有6只袜子。它们又小又暖。它们放在抽屉里。

pages.english: Here are six gloves. They are thick and woolly. They sit on the shelf.
pages.chinese: 这里有6只手套。它们又厚又毛。它们放在架子上。

pages.english: Here are six pants. They are long and folded. They lie on the shelf.
pages.chinese: 这里有6条长裤。它们又长又叠好了。它们放在架子上。

pages.english: Here are six shorts. They are short and light. They are in my bag.
pages.chinese: 这里有6条短裤。它们又短又轻。它们在我包里。

pages.english: Here are six coats. They are warm and long. They hang by the door.
pages.chinese: 这里有6件外套。它们又暖又长。它们挂在门边。

pages.english: Here are six hats. They are bright and round. They hang on the hooks.
pages.chinese: 这里有6顶帽子。它们又亮又圆。它们挂在钩子上。

pages.english: Here are seven worms. They are pink and wiggly. They live in the wet dirt.
pages.chinese: 这里有7条蚯蚓。它们粉粉的，扭来扭去。它们住在湿土里。

pages.english: Here are seven spiders. They are small and hairy. They sit in their webs.
pages.chinese: 这里有7只蜘蛛。它们又小又毛。它们待在网里。

pages.english: Here are seven lizards. They are green and slim. They lie on the warm rocks.
pages.chinese: 这里有7只蜥蜴。它们又绿又细。它们趴在暖石头上。

pages.english: Here are seven snails. They are small with shells. They creep on the wet leaves.
pages.chinese: 这里有7只蜗牛。它们很小，背着壳。它们在湿叶子上慢慢爬。

pages.english: Here are seven ladybugs. They are red with spots. They sit on the leaf.
pages.chinese: 这里有7只瓢虫。它们红红的，带点点。它们停在叶子上。

pages.english: Here are seven frogs. They are green and shiny. They sit by the pond. They go ribbit, ribbit.
pages.chinese: 这里有7只青蛙。它们又绿又亮。它们蹲在池塘边。它们呱呱叫。

pages.english: Here are seven snakes. They are green and smooth. They slide through the grass.
pages.chinese: 这里有7条蛇。它们又绿又滑。它们在草里滑过。

pages.english: Here are seven turtles. They are green with shells. They walk on the sand.
pages.chinese: 这里有7只乌龟。它们绿绿的，背着壳。它们在沙上走。

pages.english: Here are eight backpacks. They are full and colourful. They stand by the door.
pages.chinese: 这里有8个背包。它们装得满满的，五颜六色。它们放在门边。

pages.english: Here are eight raincoats. They are yellow and bright. They hang on the hook.
pages.chinese: 这里有8件雨衣。它们是亮黄色的。它们挂在钩子上。

pages.english: Here are eight lamps. They are small and warm. They stand on the desks.
pages.chinese: 这里有8盏台灯。它们又小又暖。它们放在书桌上。

pages.english: Here are eight hot dogs. They are long and warm. They lie on the plate.
pages.chinese: 这里有8个热狗。它们又长又热乎。它们放在盘子里。

pages.english: Here are eight cups. They are full of juice. They stand on the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有8个杯子。它们装满了果汁。它们放在桌上。

pages.english: Here are eight chairs. They are small and wooden. They fill the room.
pages.chinese: 这里有8把椅子。它们又小又是木头的。它们占满了房间。

pages.english: Here are eight logs. They are brown and heavy. They lie by the fire.
pages.chinese: 这里有8根木头。它们又棕又重。它们堆在火边。

pages.english: Here are eight friends. They are smiling and kind. They stand in the yard.
pages.chinese: 这里有8位朋友。他们笑着，很友善。他们站在院子里。

pages.english: Here are nine cows. They are black and white. They stand in the barn. They go moo, moo.
pages.chinese: 这里有9头奶牛。它们是黑白色的。它们待在牛棚里。它们哞哞叫。

pages.english: Here are nine pigs. They are pink and chubby. They sit in the mud. They go oink, oink.
pages.chinese: 这里有9只猪。它们粉粉的，胖胖的。它们待着泥里。它们哼哼叫。

pages.english: Here are nine goats. They are white with horns. They climb on the rocks. They go maa, maa.
pages.chinese: 这里有9只山羊。它们白白的，有角。它们在石头上爬。它们咩咩叫。

pages.english: Here are nine sheep. They are grey with wool. They stand on the hill. They go baa, baa.
pages.chinese: 这里有9只绵羊。它们灰灰的，有羊毛。它们站在小山上。它们咩咩叫。

pages.english: Here are nine horses. They are brown and tall. They run in the field. They go neigh, neigh.
pages.chinese: 这里有9匹马。它们又棕又高。它们在田里跑。它们咴咴叫。

pages.english: Here are nine bulls. They are dark and strong. They stand behind the fence.
pages.chinese: 这里有9头公牛。它们颜色深，很强壮。它们站在篱笆后。

pages.english: Here are nine chickens. They are brown with combs. They walk in the yard. They go cluck, cluck.
pages.chinese: 这里有9只鸡。它们棕棕色，有鸡冠。它们在院子里走。它们咯咯叫。

pages.english: Here are nine geese. They are white with long necks. They swim on the pond. They go honk, honk.
pages.chinese: 这里有9只鹅。它们白白的，脖子很长。它们在池塘里游。它们嘎嘎叫。

pages.english: Here are ten apples. They are red and shiny. They fill the basket. They go crunch, crunch.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个苹果。它们红红的，亮亮的。它们装满了篮子。咬起来咔嚓咔嚓。

pages.english: Here are ten carrots. They are long and orange. They lie in the box.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个胡萝卜。它们又长又橙。它们装在箱子里。

pages.english: Here are ten beets. They are red and round. They grow in the soil.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个甜菜。它们又红又圆。它们长在土里。

pages.english: Here are ten tomatoes. They are red and smooth. They hang on the vine.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个西红柿。它们又红又滑。它们挂在藤上。

pages.english: Here are ten strawberries. They are red with seeds. They sit in the bowl.
pages.chinese: 这里有10颗草莓。它们红红的，带着小籽。它们装在碗里。

pages.english: Here are ten pears. They are yellow and sweet. They hang on the tree.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个梨。它们黄黄的，甜甜的。它们挂在树上。

pages.english: Here are ten potatoes. They are brown and lumpy. They lie in the sack.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个土豆。它们棕棕色，疙疙瘩瘩。它们装在麻袋里。

pages.english: Here are ten lemons. They are yellow and sour. They sit on the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有10个柠檬。它们黄黄的，酸酸的。它们放在桌上。

pages.english: Here are eleven cards. They are colourful and flat. They lie on the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有11张卡片。它们花花绿绿，扁扁的。它们放在桌上。

pages.english: Here are eleven hats. They are bright and pointy. They sit on our heads.
pages.chinese: 这里有11顶帽子。它们又亮又尖。它们戴在我们头上。

pages.english: Here are eleven cupcakes. They are small with icing. They fill the tray.
pages.chinese: 这里有11个纸杯蛋糕。它们小小个，上面有糖霜。它们装满了托盘。

pages.english: Here are eleven candies. They are bright and wrapped. They sit in the jar.
pages.chinese: 这里有11颗糖。它们亮亮的，包着糖纸。它们装罐子里。

pages.english: Here are eleven balloons. They are round and shiny. They float in the air.
pages.chinese: 这里有11个气球。它们又圆又亮。它们飘在空中。

pages.english: Here are eleven pizzas. They are round and cheesy. They come in boxes.
pages.chinese: 这里有11个披萨。它们圆圆，上面有奶酪。它们装在盒子里。

pages.english: Here are eleven gifts. They are wrapped with paper. They sit under the tree.
pages.chinese: 这里有11个礼物。它们用纸包着。它们放在树下。

pages.english: Here are eleven friends. They are smiling and loud. They fill the room.
pages.chinese: 这里有11位朋友。他们笑着，声音很响。他们挤满了房间。

pages.english: Here are twelve aprons. They are white and tied. They hang on the hooks.
pages.chinese: 这里有12条围裙。它们白白的，系着带子。它们挂在钩子上。

pages.english: Here are twelve cups. They are white and clean. They stand on the shelf.
pages.chinese: 这里有12个杯子。它们又白又干净。它们放在架子上。

pages.english: Here are twelve spoons. They are silver and small. They lie in the drawer.
pages.chinese: 这里有12个勺子。它们银色，小小个。它们放在抽屉里。

pages.english: Here are twelve cookies. They are brown with chips. They sit on the plate.
pages.chinese: 这里有12块饼干。它们棕棕色，带巧克力豆。它们放在盘子里。

pages.english: Here are twelve hats. They are soft and round. They hang on the rack.
pages.chinese: 这里有12顶帽子。它们又软又圆。它们挂在架子上。

pages.english: Here are twelve bowls. They are white and wide. They stand on the table.
pages.chinese: 这里有12个碗。它们又白又宽。它们放在桌上。

pages.english: Here are twelve pans. They are dark and round. They sit on the stove.
pages.chinese: 这里有12个锅。它们黑黑的，圆圆的。它们放在炉子上。

pages.english: Here are twelve plates. They are white and flat. They lie in the cupboard.
pages.chinese: 这里有12个盘子。它们又白又平。它们放在橱柜里。

pages.english: Here is one bug. It is little and red. It sits on the green leaf. There is only one.
pages.chinese: 这里有一只虫子。它小小个，红红的。它趴在绿叶上。只有一只。

pages.english: Now there are three bugs. They crawl along the leaf. They are red with spots. One, two, three.
pages.chinese: 现在有3只虫子。它们沿着叶子爬。它们红红的，带点点。一、二、三。

pages.english: Now there are five bugs. They line up on the leaf. They are very small. Let us count them.
pages.chinese: 现在有5只虫子。它们在叶子上排成一排。它们非常小。我们来数一数。

pages.english: Now there are seven bugs. They are all over the stem. They are busy and quick. Seven is a lot.
pages.chinese: 现在有7只虫子。它们爬满了花茎。它们忙忙碌碌，爬得快。7个真不少。

pages.english: Here are two bugs. One sits on each petal. They are red and round. Two is easy.
pages.chinese: 这里有2只虫子。每片花瓣上有一只。它们红红的，圆圆的。2个好数。

pages.english: Here are four bugs. They sit on the leaf. Their backs are round. One, two, three, four.
pages.chinese: 这里有4只虫子。它们趴在叶子上。它们的背圆圆的。一、二、三、四。

pages.english: Now there are six bugs. They crawl everywhere. They cover the leaf. Six bugs in all.
pages.chinese: 现在有6只虫子。它们到处爬。它们盖满了叶子。一共6只。

pages.english: Now there are many bugs. They cover the whole flower. They are red and tiny. There are too many to count.
pages.chinese: 现在有好多虫子。它们爬满了整朵花。它们红红的，小小的。多得数不清了。

pages.english: This is the head. It is small and round. It has two little feelers. There is one head.
pages.chinese: 这是它的头。它又小又圆。它有两根小触角。只有一个头。

pages.english: Here is one leg. It is thin and long. It rests on the leaf. There is only one.
pages.chinese: 这里有一条腿。它又细又长。它搭在叶子上。只有一条。

pages.english: Now there are three legs. They are thin and quick. They hold the leaf. One, two, three.
pages.chinese: 现在有3条腿。它们又细又快。它们抓住叶子。一、二、三。

pages.english: Now there are five legs. They wiggle as it walks. They are small and thin. Five legs now.
pages.chinese: 现在有5条腿。它走路时这些腿会动。它们又小又细。现在有5条腿。

pages.english: This is the body. It is long and oval. It is green and smooth. There is one body.
pages.chinese: 这是它的身体。它又长又椭圆。它绿绿的，很光滑。只有一个身体。

pages.english: Here are two more legs. They are on this side. Now count again. We add two.
pages.chinese: 这里又多了2条腿。它们长在这一边。现在再数一次。我们加上2条。

pages.english: Now there are four legs. They are even and thin. They stand on the leaf. Four legs so far.
pages.chinese: 现在有4条腿。它们又匀又细。它们站在叶子上。到现在有4条腿。

pages.english: Now there are six legs. Six legs on one small body. That is an insect. It can walk and climb.
pages.chinese: 现在有6条腿。一个小小的身体上有6条腿。这就是昆虫。它能走，也能爬。

pages.english: Here is one letter. It is the letter A. It is big and clear. There is only one.
pages.chinese: 这里有一个字母。它是字母A。它又大又清楚。只有一个。

pages.english: Now there are three letters. They make the word fun. The letters are f, u, n. Fun means happy.
pages.chinese: 现在有3个字母。它们拼成fun这个词。字母是f、u、n。fun就是开心的意思。

pages.english: Now there are five letters. They make the word happy. The letters are h, a, p, p, y. Happy is how we feel.
pages.chinese: 现在有5个字母。它们拼成happy这个词。字母是h、a、p、p、y。happy就是我们开心的感觉。

pages.english: Now there are seven letters. They make the word morning. It is a long word. Morning comes after night.
pages.chinese: 现在有7个字母。它们拼成morning这个词。这是一个长单词。morning就是早上。

pages.english: Here are two letters. They make the word my. My means it is mine. It is a short word.
pages.chinese: 这里有2个字母。它们拼成my这个词。my就是“我的”。这是一个短词。

pages.english: Here are four letters. They make the word play. Play means to have fun. Let us play now.
pages.chinese: 这里有4个字母。它们拼成play这个词。play就是玩。我们现在玩吧。

pages.english: Here are six letters. They make the word school. School is where we learn. It starts with s.
pages.chinese: 这里有6个字母。它们拼成school这个词。school就是我们上学的地方。它用s开头。

pages.english: Here is one big word. It is made of many letters. The letters sit side by side. Words are made of letters.
pages.chinese: 这里有一个大单词。它由很多字母组成。字母一个挨着一个。单词是由字母组成的。

pages.english: This is a gate. It is made of wood. It has a wide open frame. It stands at the end.
pages.chinese: 这是一道大门。它是木头做的。它有一个宽宽的框。它立在尽头。

pages.english: This is the sidewalk. It is grey. It is made of flat slabs. It runs beside the road.
pages.chinese: 这是人行道。它是灰色的。它由一块块平板铺成。它沿着马路延伸。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are red. Their petals are small and soft. They grow in a pot.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是红色的。花瓣又小又软。它们长在花盆里。

pages.english: These are friends. They are happy. They have big warm smiles. They stand on the path.
pages.chinese: 这些是朋友。他们很开心。他们笑得很暖。他们站在小路上。

pages.english: This is a mailbox. It is blue. It has a boxy metal body. It stands by the gate.
pages.chinese: 这是一个邮箱。它是蓝色的。它的身体方方的，是金属的。它立在大门旁。

pages.english: This is a fence. It is white. It has short thin posts. It goes around the yard.
pages.chinese: 这是一道篱笆。它是白色的。它有一根根短短的细柱。它围着院子。

pages.english: This is a bike. It is red. It has two round wheels. It waits on the path.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆自行车。它是红色的。它有两个圆轮子。它停在小路上。

pages.english: This is the street. It is quiet today. There are houses and trees. We walk down it.
pages.chinese: 这是街道。今天很安静。这里有房子和树。我们沿着它走。

pages.english: These are steps. They are made of stone. They are wide and flat. They lead to the door.
pages.chinese: 这些是台阶。它们是石头做的。它们又宽又平。它们通到门口。

pages.english: This is food. It is hot and tasty. It sits on the cart. People buy it here.
pages.chinese: 这是食物。它又热又香。它放在小车上。人们在这里买。

pages.english: This is a taxi. It is yellow. It has four round wheels. It waits on the road.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆出租车。它是黄色的。它有四个圆轮子。它停在路边。

pages.english: These are people. They are busy. They walk and talk. They fill the sidewalk.
pages.chinese: 这些是人。他们很忙。他们边走边说。他们挤满了人行道。

pages.english: This is the sidewalk. It is grey. It has flat square slabs. It runs by the shops.
pages.chinese: 这是人行道。它是灰色的。它由方方的平板铺成。它沿着商店延伸。

pages.english: This is a building. It is tall. It has many glass windows. It stands at the corner.
pages.chinese: 这是一栋楼。它很高。它有很多玻璃窗。它立在转角。

pages.english: This is a bus. It is long and red. It has many seats. It stops at the corner.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆公共汽车。它又长又红。它有很多座位。它停在街角。

pages.english: This is the street. It is noisy. There are cars and signs. We look both ways.
pages.chinese: 这是街道。它很吵。这里有车，也有标志。我们左右都看一看。

pages.english: This is a street. It is long and grey. Cars go up and down. People walk along it.
pages.chinese: 这是一条街道。它又长又灰。车来来往往。人们沿着它走。

pages.english: This is a bus. It is big and red. It has many seats. It stops at the corner.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆公共汽车。它又大又红。它有很多座位。它停在街角。

pages.english: This is a park. It is green. It has trees and grass. Children run here.
pages.chinese: 这是一个公园。它是绿色的。它有树，有草地。孩子们在这里跑。

pages.english: These are people. There are many of them. They walk very fast. They fill the sidewalk.
pages.chinese: 这些是人。人很多。他们走得很快。他们占满了人行道。

pages.english: This is a car. It is small and bright. It has four wheels. It drives in the lane.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆汽车。它又小又亮。它有四个轮子。它在车道里开。

pages.english: This is a shop. It has a bright window. It stands on the corner. We buy snacks here.
pages.chinese: 这是一家商店。它有一个明亮的橱窗。它立在转角。我们在这里买小吃。

pages.english: These are buildings. They are very tall. Their windows are high up. They stand all around.
pages.chinese: 这些是高楼。它们非常高。它们的窗户高在高处。它们围在四周。

pages.english: This is noise. It is loud. Cars, horns and voices. The city is never quiet.
pages.chinese: 这是噪音。它很响。有车声、喇叭声和人声。城市从来不安静。

pages.english: This is the gate. It is made of metal. It has a wide open frame. We run through it.
pages.chinese: 这是大门。它是金属做的。它有一个宽宽的框。我们从这里跑进去。

pages.english: This is the slide. It is blue. It has a smooth long slope. We slide down it.
pages.chinese: 这是滑梯。它是蓝色的。它有一道又长又滑的坡。我们从上面滑下来。

pages.english: This is the ladder. It is made of metal. It has step after step. We climb up it.
pages.chinese: 这是梯子。它是金属做的。它一级一级往上。我们爬上去。

pages.english: This is a wheel. It is round. It has spokes like a star. We turn it around.
pages.chinese: 这是一个轮子。它是圆的。它的辐条像星星。我们把它转起来。

pages.english: This is the swing. It is blue. It has two long ropes. We swing up high.
pages.chinese: 这是秋千。它是蓝色的。它有两根长绳。我们荡得很高。

pages.english: This is the sandbox. The sand is golden. It is soft and deep. We dig in it.
pages.chinese: 这是沙箱。沙子是金黄色的。它又软又深。我们在里面挖。

pages.english: This is the bridge. It is made of wood. It has a curved little path. We walk across it.
pages.chinese: 这是小桥。它是木头做的。它有一道弯弯的小路。我们从上面走过去。

pages.english: This is the playground. The sun is out. There are slides and swings. We play all day.
pages.chinese: 这是操场。太阳出来了。这里有滑梯和秋千。我们玩一整天。

pages.english: These are lights. They are twinkly and bright. They hang on the tree. We count them.
pages.chinese: 这些是灯。它们一闪一闪，很亮。它们挂在树上。我们数一数。

pages.english: This is eggnog. It is creamy and sweet. It sits in the mug. It is warm in my hands.
pages.chinese: 这是蛋奶酒。它又浓又甜。它装在杯子里。捧在手里暖暖的。

pages.english: These are cards. They are folded paper. They lie on the table. We read them one by one.
pages.chinese: 这些是卡片。它们是折起来的纸。它们放在桌上。我们一张张读。

pages.english: These are stockings. They are red. They are long and soft. They hang by the fire.
pages.chinese: 这是圣诞袜。它们是红色的。它们又长又软。它们挂在火边。

pages.english: This is dinner. It is warm and rich. There is roast and sweets. We eat together.
pages.chinese: 这是晚饭。它又热又丰盛。有烤肉，也有甜食。我们一起吃。

pages.english: This is the tree. It is green. It has bright shiny balls. It stands in the room.
pages.chinese: 这是圣诞树。它是绿色的。它上面有亮亮的球。它立在房间里。

pages.english: These are gifts. They are wrapped with paper. They have pretty bows. They sit under the tree.
pages.chinese: 这些是礼物。它们用纸包着。它们有漂亮的蝴蝶结。它们放在树下。

pages.english: These are cookies. They are round and sweet. They lie on the plate. We leave some for Santa.
pages.chinese: 这些是饼干。它们又圆又甜。它们放在盘子里。我们留一些给圣诞老人。

pages.english: This is my family. They are close and warm. We all sit together. Everyone is smiling.
pages.chinese: 这是我的家人。他们亲近又温暖。我们坐在一起。每个人都在笑。

pages.english: This is my bread. It is round and golden. It has a soft crust. We share it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的面包。它又圆又金。它的外皮软软的。我们分着吃。

pages.english: These are my gifts. They are wrapped with paper. They have ribbons on top. I hold them in my hands.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的礼物。它们用纸包着。上面系着丝带。我把它们捧在手里。

pages.english: These are my cookies. They are small and sweet. They lie on the plate. I eat one slowly.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的饼干。它们又小又甜。它们放在盘子里。我慢慢吃一块。

pages.english: These are my candles. They are small and bright. They stand in the menorah. We light them at night.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的蜡烛。它们又小又亮。它们插在烛台上。我们在晚上点它们。

pages.english: These are my toys. They are bright and new. They lie on the floor. I play with them.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的玩具。它们又亮又新。它们放在地上。我和它们玩。

pages.english: This is my candy. It is sweet and golden. It sits in my pocket. I share it with my sister.
pages.chinese: 这是我的糖。它又甜又金。它在我口袋里。我和姐姐分着吃。

pages.english: This is my Hanukkah. It has eight bright nights. We light candles and eat together. It is happy and warm.
pages.chinese: 这是我的光明节。它有八个明亮的夜晚。我们点蜡烛，一起吃饭。它快乐又温暖。

pages.english: This is my cake. It is sweet and soft. It has white frosting on top. I eat a big bite.
pages.chinese: 这是我的蛋糕。它又甜又软。上面有白色的糖霜。我吃一大口。

pages.english: This is my cupcake. It is small and round. It has a swirl of icing. I eat it all up.
pages.chinese: 这是我的纸杯蛋糕。它又小又圆。上面有一圈糖霜。我全吃完了。

pages.english: This is my pie. It is warm and golden. It has a thick crust. I take one slice.
pages.chinese: 这是我的派。它又热又金。它的外皮厚厚的。我拿一片。

pages.english: This is my candy. It is bright and sweet. It sits in the jar. I take just one.
pages.chinese: 这是我的糖。它又亮又甜。它装在罐子里。我只拿一颗。

pages.english: This is my cookie. It is round and crunchy. It has chocolate chips. I munch it up.
pages.chinese: 这是我的饼干。它又圆又脆。上面有巧克力豆。我咔嚓咔嚓吃掉。

pages.english: This is my ice cream. It is cold and sweet. It has a soft round scoop. I lick it slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是我的冰激凌。它又冷又甜。上面有一个圆圆的球。我慢慢舔。

pages.english: This is my brownie. It is dark and rich. It is cut in a square. I nibble the edge.
pages.chinese: 这是我的布朗尼。它颜色深，味道浓。它切成方块。我一点点咬边。

pages.english: This is my tummy. It is round and full. I ate too many sweets. Now I feel too full.
pages.chinese: 这是我的肚子。它圆鼓鼓的。我吃了太多甜食。现在我觉得太饱了。

pages.english: These are my friends. They are happy. They smile and wave. We sit together.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的朋友。他们很开心。他们笑着挥手。我们坐在一起。

pages.english: This is my milk. It is white and cold. It comes in a small carton. I drink it up.
pages.chinese: 这是我的牛奶。它又白又凉。它装在一个小盒里。我把它喝完。

pages.english: These are my carrots. They are orange and crunchy. They lie in my box. I crunch them.
pages.chinese: 这是我的胡萝卜。它们橙橙色，脆脆的。它们在我的盒子里。我咔嚓咔嚓吃。

pages.english: This is my napkin. It is soft and white. It lies on my lap. I wipe my mouth.
pages.chinese: 这是我的纸巾。它又软又白。它放在我腿上。我擦擦嘴。

pages.english: This is my bag. It is made of paper. It stands on the chair. I open it up.
pages.chinese: 这是我的午餐袋。它是纸做的。它放在椅子上。我把它打开。

pages.english: These are my noodles. They are long and soft. They sit in my bowl. I slurp them up.
pages.chinese: 这是我的面条。它们又长又软。它们在碗里。我吸溜吸溜吃。

pages.english: This is my cookie. It is small and sweet. I eat it last. It is a little treat.
pages.chinese: 这是我的饼干。它又小又甜。我最后吃它。它是一点小奖励。

pages.english: This is my lunch. It is warm and tasty. I eat it all. Then I play outside.
pages.chinese: 这是我的午餐。它又热又香。我全部吃完。然后我到外面玩。

pages.english: This is a gift. It is wrapped with paper. It has a bow on top. I hold it in my hands.
pages.chinese: 这是一份礼物。它用纸包着。上面有一个蝴蝶结。我把它捧在手里。

pages.english: These are cookies. They are shaped like hearts. They are sweet and crisp. I share them.
pages.chinese: 这些是饼干。它们是心形的。它们又甜又脆。我分给大家。

pages.english: This is candy. It is bright and sweet. It sits in the jar. I give some away.
pages.chinese: 这是糖。它又亮又甜。它装在罐子里。我分一些出去。

pages.english: This is chocolate. It is brown and smooth. It sits in a box. I eat a small piece.
pages.chinese: 这是巧克力。它又棕又滑。它装在盒子里。我吃一小块。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are red. Their petals are soft. I give them to my mom.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是红色的。花瓣软软的。我把它们送给妈妈。

pages.english: This is a balloon. It is red and round. It floats on a string. I hold the string.
pages.chinese: 这是一个气球。它又红又圆。它系在绳子上飘着。我拉着绳子。

pages.english: This is a bear. It is soft and brown. It has little arms. I hug it tight.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小熊。它又软又棕。它有小小的胳膊。我紧紧抱着它。

pages.english: This is Valentine's Day. There are hearts everywhere. We give gifts and say kind words. It is a sweet day.
pages.chinese: 这是情人节。到处是爱心。我们送礼物，说温暖的话。这是甜甜的一天。

pages.english: This pasta is long. It looks like thin strings. It lies in the pot. We slurp it up.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面很长。它看起来像细细的线。它在锅里。我们吸溜着吃。

pages.english: This pasta is red. It has sauce on top. It sits in the bowl. We stir it around.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面是红色的。上面有酱。它在碗里。我们拌一拌。

pages.english: This pasta is wide. It looks like flat ribbons. It lies on the plate. We fold it up.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面很宽。它像扁扁的丝带。它在盘子里。我们把它卷起来。

pages.english: This pasta is curly. It has twisty shapes. It sits in the bowl. We twirl it with a fork.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面是卷的。它的形状弯弯扭扭。它在碗里。我们用叉子卷着吃。

pages.english: This pasta is short. It is cut in small pieces. It fills my spoon. We scoop it up.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面很短。它被切成小块。它装满我的勺子。我们舀起来吃。

pages.english: This pasta is green. It has spinach in it. It lies on the plate. We try a little.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面是绿色的。里面加了菠菜。它在盘子里。我们尝一点。

pages.english: This pasta is thin. It is light and narrow. It sits in the pot. We lift it out.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面很细。它又轻又窄。它在锅里。我们把它捞出来。

pages.english: This pasta is yummy. It is warm and soft. It fills my tummy. We eat it all up.
pages.chinese: 这种意大利面很好吃。它又热又软。它填饱我的肚子。我们吃得干干净净。

pages.english: This is the day. It is sunny and quiet. I have a secret plan. I wait all morning.
pages.chinese: 这一天到了。天气晴朗，很安静。我有一个小秘密。我等了一整个早上。

pages.english: This is a box. It is small and square. It sits on the table. I put my gift inside.
pages.chinese: 这是一个盒子。它又小又方。它放在桌上。我把礼物放进去。

pages.english: This is a bow. It is red. It is curly and soft. I tie it on the box.
pages.chinese: 这是一个蝴蝶结。它是红色的。它卷卷的，软软的。我把它系在盒子上。

pages.english: This is my smile. It is big and warm. It is on my face. I give it to mom.
pages.chinese: 这是我的笑。笑得大大的，暖暖的。它挂在我脸上。我把它送给妈妈。

pages.english: This is a bowl. It is blue and round. It sits in the kitchen. I fill it with fruit.
pages.chinese: 这是一个碗。它又蓝又圆。它在厨房里。我在里面装满水果。

pages.english: This is paper. It is bright and soft. It lies on the floor. I wrap the gift with it.
pages.chinese: 这是纸。它又亮又软。它铺在地上。我用它包礼物。

pages.english: This is the gift. It is wrapped with paper. It has a red bow. I give it to mom.
pages.chinese: 这是礼物。它用纸包着。它有一个红蝴蝶结。我把它送给妈妈。

pages.english: This is a hug. It is warm and tight. My arms go around mom. She hugs me back.
pages.chinese: 这是一个拥抱。它又暖又紧。我的手臂抱住妈妈。她也抱住我。

pages.english: These are peas. They are green and round. They sit in a pod. We pop them out.
pages.chinese: 这些是豌豆。它们又绿又圆。它们待在豆荚里。我们把它们剥出来。

pages.english: This is a watermelon. It is green with stripes. It is heavy and round. It lies on the ground.
pages.chinese: 这是一个西瓜。它绿绿的，有条纹。它又重又圆。它躺在地上。

pages.english: These are potatoes. They are brown and lumpy. They hide under the soil. We dig them up.
pages.chinese: 这些是土豆。它们棕棕色，疙疙瘩瘩。它们藏在土下面。我们把它们挖出来。

pages.english: This is corn. It is yellow. The kernels sit in rows. It grows on a tall stalk.
pages.chinese: 这是玉米。它是黄色的。玉米粒一排排长着。它长在高高的秆上。

pages.english: These are bean pods. They are green and long. They hang on the vine. We pick them.
pages.chinese: 这些是豆荚。它们又绿又长。它们挂在藤上。我们摘下来。

pages.english: These are onions. They are round. They have dry papery skin. They grow in the dirt.
pages.chinese: 这些是洋葱。它们是圆的。它们的皮干干的，像纸。它们长在土里。

pages.english: These are tomatoes. They are red and smooth. They hang on the vine. We pick them.
pages.chinese: 这些是西红柿。它们又红又滑。它们挂在藤上。我们摘下来。

pages.english: This is the garden. It is green and full. There are rows of plants. We water it every day.
pages.chinese: 这是花园。它绿意满满。这里有一排排植物。我们每天给它浇水。

pages.english: This is a beach ball. It has wide stripes. It is big and light. We bounce it on the sand.
pages.chinese: 这是一个沙滩球。它有一道道宽条纹。它又大又轻。我们在沙上拍它。

pages.english: This is a basketball. It is orange. It has a bumpy surface. We dribble it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个篮球。它是橙色的。它的表面疙疙瘩瘩。我们拍着它走。

pages.english: This is a tennis ball. It is yellow. It is soft and fuzzy. We hit it over the net.
pages.chinese: 这是一个网球。它是黄色的。它软软的，毛茸茸。我们把它打过网。

pages.english: This is a soccer ball. It is black and white. It has patches all over. We kick it on the grass.
pages.chinese: 这是一个足球。它是黑白色的。它表面一块一块的。我们在草地上踢它。

pages.english: This is a baseball. It is small and white. It is hard and round. We throw it to a friend.
pages.chinese: 这是一个棒球。它又小又白。它又硬又圆。我们把它扔给朋友。

pages.english: This is a football. It is brown. It has a long oval shape. We pass it down the field.
pages.chinese: 这是一个橄榄球。它是棕色的。它是长长的椭圆形。我们在场上传它。

pages.english: This is a golf ball. It is small and white. It has tiny dimples. We tap it into the hole.
pages.chinese: 这是一个高尔夫球。它又小又白。它上面有很多小坑。我们把它轻打进洞。

pages.english: This is a volleyball. It is white and soft. It flies over the net. We hit it back.
pages.chinese: 这是一个排球。它又白又软。它飞过网。我们再打回去。

pages.english: This is the field. The grass is green. It is mown and neat. The game is played here.
pages.chinese: 这是球场。草地是绿色的。它剪得整整齐齐。比赛在这里进行。

pages.english: This is a bat. It is made of wood. It is long and smooth. The player swings it.
pages.chinese: 这是一根球棒。它是木头做的。它又长又滑。球员挥动它。

pages.english: This is a cap. It is blue. It has a round brim. The player wears it.
pages.chinese: 这是一顶帽子。它是蓝色的。它有一个圆帽檐。球员戴着它。

pages.english: This is a uniform. It is white. It has a number on the back. The team wears it.
pages.chinese: 这是一套球服。它是白色的。背后有一个号码。全队都穿它。

pages.english: This is a base. It is white and flat. It lies on the ground. The runner runs to it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个垒。它又白又平。它放在地上。跑垒员跑向它。

pages.english: This is the baseball. It is small and white. It flies through the air. The batter hits it.
pages.chinese: 这是棒球。它又小又白。它在空中飞。击球手打它。

pages.english: This is a helmet. It is hard and round. It protects the head. The batter wears it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个头盔。它又硬又圆。它保护头部。击球手戴着它。

pages.english: This is the team. They wear the same colours. They stand on the field. We cheer for them.
pages.chinese: 这是一支球队。他们穿一样颜色的衣服。他们站在场上。我们为他们加油。

pages.english: These are clothes. They are clean and folded. They lie in the bag. We pack them for the trip.
pages.chinese: 这些是衣服。它们干净，叠好了。它们放在包里。我们收拾它们去旅行。

pages.english: This is a map. It is made of paper. It has lines and little marks. We read it in the car.
pages.chinese: 这是一张地图。它是纸做的。上面有线条和小标记。我们在车里看它。

pages.english: This is a seat belt. It is long and tight. It goes across my chest. I click it on.
pages.chinese: 这是安全带。它又长又紧。它横过我的胸前。我把它扣好。

pages.english: This is a book. It is bright and flat. It lies on my lap. I read it on the way.
pages.chinese: 这是一本书。它又亮又扁。它放在我腿上。我在路上读它。

pages.english: This is a suitcase. It is yellow and big. It has four wheels. We roll it along.
pages.chinese: 这是一个行李箱。它又黄又大。它有四个轮子。我们拉着它走。

pages.english: This is the car. It is blue. It waits in the driveway. We get in and go.
pages.chinese: 这是我们的车。它是蓝色的。它停在车道上。我们上车出发。

pages.english: This is our dog. It is brown. It sits in the back seat. It wags its tail.
pages.chinese: 这是我们的狗。它是棕色的。它坐在后座。它摇着尾巴。

pages.english: These are my grandparents. They are kind and smiling. They wait for us at the door. We hug them hello.
pages.chinese: 这是我的爷爷奶奶。他们很和善，一直在笑。他们在门口等我们。我们抱一抱打招呼。

pages.english: This is a cart. It is made of metal. It has four little wheels. We push it down the aisle.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆购物车。它是金属做的。它有四个小轮子。我们推着它过货架。

pages.english: These are vegetables. They are green and fresh. They lie on the shelf. We pick some.
pages.chinese: 这些是蔬菜。它们绿绿的，很新鲜。它们摆在货架上。我们挑一些。

pages.english: This is cereal. It comes in a tall box. The box is bright. We choose one.
pages.chinese: 这是麦片。它装在高高的盒子里。盒子很鲜艳。我们选一盒。

pages.english: These are eggs. They are white and oval. They sit in a carton. We carry them carefully.
pages.chinese: 这些是鸡蛋。它们白白的，椭圆形。它们装在蛋盒里。我们小心地拿着。

pages.english: This is fruit. It is colourful and juicy. It lies in a big pile. We pick some.
pages.chinese: 这是水果。它们五颜六色，多汁。它们堆成一大堆。我们挑一些。

pages.english: This is bread. It is soft and warm. It comes in a bag. We put it in the cart.
pages.chinese: 这是面包。它又软又热。它装在袋子里。我们把它放进车里。

pages.english: This is meat. It is fresh and red. It is wrapped in paper. It sits in the cold case.
pages.chinese: 这是肉。它很新鲜，红红的。它用纸包着。它放在冷藏柜里。

pages.english: This is the checkout. It has a belt and a screen. It stands at the front. We pay here.
pages.chinese: 这是付款台。它有一条传送带和一个屏幕。它在最前面。我们在这里付钱。

pages.english: This is a lion. It is golden. It has a big fluffy mane. It rests in the sun. It says roar, roar.
pages.chinese: 这是一头狮子。它是金黄色的。它有一圈蓬松的大鬃毛。它在阳光下休息。它吼叫。

pages.english: This is a bear. It is brown. It has two strong paws. It sits by the rock. It says growl, growl.
pages.chinese: 这是一只熊。它是棕色的。它有两只有力的爪子。它坐在石头边。它低吼。

pages.english: This is an ape. It is dark and big. It has long strong arms. It hangs on the rope.
pages.chinese: 这是一只猿。它颜色深，个头大。它的手臂又长又有力。它挂在绳子上。

pages.english: This is a snake. It is green. It has a smooth long body. It rests on the branch. It says hiss, hiss.
pages.chinese: 这是一条蛇。它是绿色的。它的身体又滑又长。它盘在树枝上。它嘶嘶叫。

pages.english: This is a tiger. It is orange. It has black stripes. It lies in the shade. It says roar, roar.
pages.chinese: 这是一只老虎。它是橙色的。它有黑色条纹。它躺在阴凉处。它吼叫。

pages.english: This is a wolf. It is grey. It has sharp bright eyes. It walks behind the fence. It says howl, howl.
pages.chinese: 这是一只狼。它是灰色的。它的眼睛又亮又利。它在栅栏后面走。它长嚎。

pages.english: This is a chimp. It is brown and hairy. It has a wrinkly face. It sits on the platform.
pages.chinese: 这是一只黑猩猩。它棕棕色，毛茸茸。它的脸上有皱纹。它坐在平台上。

pages.english: This is a zebra. It is black and white. It has stripes all over. It eats grass. It says neigh, neigh.
pages.chinese: 这是一只斑马。它是黑白色的。它全身都是条纹。它吃草。它咴咴叫。

pages.english: This is the classroom. It is bright and tidy. The desks stand in rows. Children learn here.
pages.chinese: 这是教室。它又亮又整齐。桌子排成一排排。孩子们在这里学习。

pages.english: This is the art room. It is full of colour. There is paint and paper. Children draw here.
pages.chinese: 这是美术室。这里到处都是颜色。这里有颜料和纸。孩子们在这里画画。

pages.english: This is the library. It is quiet. There are many books on the shelves. Children read here.
pages.chinese: 这是图书室。这里很安静。书架上有很多书。孩子们在这里看书。

pages.english: This is the playground. The sun is out. There are slides and swings. Children run and play.
pages.chinese: 这是操场。太阳出来了。这里有滑梯和秋千。孩子们跑着玩。

pages.english: This is the music room. It has a piano and drums. It is happy and loud. Children sing here.
pages.chinese: 这是音乐室。这里有钢琴和鼓。这里热闹又开心。孩子们在这里唱歌。

pages.english: This is the lunchroom. It is warm and busy. There are trays and tables. Children eat here.
pages.chinese: 这是午餐室。这里又暖又热闹。这里有餐盘和桌子。孩子们在这里吃饭。

pages.english: This is the gym. It has a wide wooden floor. It is big and open. Children jump and run.
pages.chinese: 这是体育馆。它有一大片木地板。它又大又宽敞。孩子们在这里跳和跑。

pages.english: This is the school. It is big and friendly. There are teachers and children. We learn and play here.
pages.chinese: 这是学校。它又大又亲切。这里有老师和孩子。我们在这里学习和玩。

pages.english: This is a chair. It is blue. It has four short legs. I sit on it.
pages.chinese: 这是一把椅子。它是蓝色的。它有四条短腿。我坐在上面。

pages.english: This is a book. It is bright and flat. It has a colourful cover. I read it here.
pages.chinese: 这是一本书。它又亮又扁。它有一个彩色的封面。我在这里读它。

pages.english: This is a pencil. It is yellow. It has a sharp dark tip. I write with it.
pages.chinese: 这是一支铅笔。它是黄色的。它有一个尖尖的深色笔头。我用它写字。

pages.english: This is a backpack. It is red. It has two long straps. It hangs by my chair.
pages.chinese: 这是一个书包。它是红色的。它有两条长背带。它挂在我椅子边。

pages.english: This is a table. It is made of wood. It has a wide flat top. We work on it.
pages.chinese: 这是一张桌子。它是木头做的。它的桌面又宽又平。我们在上面做事。

pages.english: This is paper. It is white and smooth. It lies on the table. I draw on it.
pages.chinese: 这是纸。它又白又滑。它放在桌上。我在上面画画。

pages.english: This is an eraser. It is pink and small. It sits next to me. It takes the marks away.
pages.chinese: 这是一块橡皮。它粉色，小小个。它放在我旁边。它能把笔迹擦掉。

pages.english: This is the classroom. It is clean and quiet. There are desks and chairs. We come here to learn.
pages.chinese: 这是教室。它又干净又安静。这里有桌子和椅子。我们来这里学习。

pages.english: This is the bus. It is yellow. It has four big wheels. It waits at the gate.
pages.chinese: 这是大巴。它是黄色的。它有四个大轮子。它停在门口。

pages.english: These are games. There are balls and hoops. They lie on the grass. We play them outside.
pages.chinese: 这些是游戏。这里有球和圈。它们放在草地上。我们在外面玩。

pages.english: This is lunch. It is packed in a bag. There is a sandwich and fruit. We eat in the shade.
pages.chinese: 这是午饭。它装在一个袋子里。里面有三明治和水果。我们在阴凉处吃。

pages.english: These are songs. They are happy and loud. We clap and sing. We sing by the fire.
pages.chinese: 这些是歌。它们又快活又响亮。我们拍手唱歌。我们在火边唱歌。

pages.english: These are kids. They are smiling. They come from many places. They make friends here.
pages.chinese: 这些是孩子们。他们在笑。他们来自很多地方。他们在这里交朋友。

pages.english: This is art. There is paint and paper. It sits on the table. We draw what we see.
pages.chinese: 这是画画。这里有颜料和纸。它们放在桌上。我们画看到的东西。

pages.english: This is the lake. The water is blue. It is cool and calm. We swim in it.
pages.chinese: 这是湖。水是蓝色的。它又凉又平静。我们在里面游泳。

pages.english: This is the camp. It has tents and trees. It is out in the woods. We stay here for days.
pages.chinese: 这是营地。这里有帐篷和树。它在树林里。我们在这里住几天。

pages.english: This is a summer hat. It is light yellow. It has a wide soft brim. I wear it on my head.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的帽子。它是浅黄色的。它有一个又宽又软的帽檐。我把它戴在头上。

pages.english: This is a summer cup. It is bright and full. It has a straw on top. I drink from it.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的杯子。它很鲜艳，装得满满的。它上面有一根吸管。我用它喝水。

pages.english: This is summer food. It is fresh and cool. There is fruit and bread. We eat it outside.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的食物。它又新鲜又清凉。有水果，也有面包。我们在外面吃。

pages.english: This is a picnic. It is on a blanket. The blanket is on the grass. We sit and eat together.
pages.chinese: 这是野餐。它铺在毯子上。毯子铺在草地上。我们坐着一起吃。

pages.english: These are summer shoes. They are light and white. They have soft flat soles. I walk in the grass.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的鞋子。它们又轻又白。它们的鞋底又软又平。我穿着它们走在草上。

pages.english: This is a summer plate. It is made of paper. It is round and light. We put food on it.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的盘子。它是纸做的。它又圆又轻。我们把食物放上去。

pages.english: This is the summer sun. It is bright and yellow. It is high in the sky. It makes us warm.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的太阳。它又亮又黄。它挂在高高的天上。它把我们晒得暖暖的。

pages.english: This is summer fun. We laugh and play. The day is long. We stay out all afternoon.
pages.chinese: 这是夏天的快乐。我们又笑又玩。白天很长。我们在外面待一整个下午。

pages.english: This is the line. People stand in it. They wait inside the door. The line moves slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是队伍。人们排在里面。他们在门里面等。队伍慢慢往前挪。

pages.english: This is a box. It is brown and square. It sits on the counter. We fill it with things.
pages.chinese: 这是一个箱子。它又棕又方。它放在柜台上。我们把它装满。

pages.english: These are letters. They are white and flat. I hold them in my hand. We send them away.
pages.chinese: 这些是信。它们又白又扁。我把它们拿在手里。我们把它们寄出去。

pages.english: This is money. There are coins and notes. It lies on the counter. We pay with it.
pages.chinese: 这是钱。有硬币，也有纸币。它放在柜台上。我们用它付钱。

pages.english: This is the worker. They wear a blue uniform. They stand behind the counter. They help us here.
pages.chinese: 这是工作人员。他们穿蓝色制服。他们站在柜台后面。他们在这里帮我们。

pages.english: This is a scale. It is made of metal. It has a flat pan. We put the box on it.
pages.chinese: 这是一个秤。它是金属做的。它有一个平平的托盘。我们把箱子放上去。

pages.english: These are stamps. They are small and bright. They come in a little book. We stick one on the letter.
pages.chinese: 这些是邮票。它们又小又鲜艳。它们装在一个小本子里。我们在信上贴一张。

pages.english: This is the mailbox. It is blue and wide. It has a metal mouth. We drop the letter in.
pages.chinese: 这是邮箱。它蓝色的，很宽。它有一个金属的开口。我们把信投进去。

pages.english: This is the door. It is bright and open. It stands at the front. We walk in.
pages.chinese: 这是门。它亮堂堂的，开着。它在最前面。我们走进去。

pages.english: These are books. They are colourful. They stand on the shelves. We pick one to read.
pages.chinese: 这些是书。它们五颜六色。它们立在书架上。我们挑一本读。

pages.english: These are chairs. They are soft and low. They sit in the corner. We sit and read.
pages.chinese: 这些是椅子。它们又软又矮。它们在角落里。我们坐着看书。

pages.english: These are snacks. It is a little cafe corner. It smells warm and sweet. We buy a little treat.
pages.chinese: 这些是小吃。这是一个小小的咖啡角。这里又暖又香。我们买一点小点心。

pages.english: This is the room. It has rows of shelves. It is quiet and full of books. We walk around it.
pages.chinese: 这是这个房间。这里有一排排书架。它很安静，满是书。我们在里面走。

pages.english: This is the helper. They have a friendly smile. They stand by the desk. They help us find books.
pages.chinese: 这是店员。他们笑得很亲切。他们站在桌边。他们帮我们找书。

pages.english: These are stories. They are in every book. They have words and pictures. We choose one to take home.
pages.chinese: 这些是故事。每本书里都有。它们有文字，也有图画。我们挑一本带回家。

pages.english: This is the bookstore. It is cosy and warm. It sits on the street. We come here again and again.
pages.chinese: 这是书店。它又舒服又温暖。它在街边。我们一次又一次地来。

pages.english: This is a ticket. It is a small paper slip. It has words and numbers. I hold it in my hand.
pages.chinese: 这是一张机票。它是一小张纸。上面有字，也有数字。我把它拿在手里。

pages.english: This is a bag. It is small and soft. It goes above my seat. I open it up.
pages.chinese: 这是一个包。它又小又软。它放在我座位上方。我把它打开。

pages.english: This is the window. It is small and round. It is beside my seat. I look outside.
pages.chinese: 这是窗户。它又小又圆。它在我座位旁边。我往外看。

pages.english: This is the sky. It is blue and wide. There are clouds far below. We fly through it.
pages.chinese: 这是天空。它又蓝又宽。下面很远的地方有云。我们从中间飞过。

pages.english: This is the pilot. They wear a neat uniform. They sit in the front. They fly the plane.
pages.chinese: 这是飞行员。他们穿着整齐的制服。他们坐在最前面。他们开飞机。

pages.english: These are seats. They are blue and soft. They stand in rows. We buckle in.
pages.chinese: 这些是座位。它们蓝色的，软软的。它们一排排的。我们系好安全带。

pages.english: These are snacks. They come on a small tray. They are small and tasty. We eat them on the way.
pages.chinese: 这些是小吃。它们放在小托盘上。它们又小又好吃。我们在路上吃。

pages.english: This is the airplane. It is white and big. It has two long wings. It flies up in the clouds.
pages.chinese: 这是飞机。它又白又大。它有两片长翅膀。它飞进云里。

pages.english: These are stairs. They are grey and steep. They go down. We go down to the train.
pages.chinese: 这是台阶。它们又灰又陡。它们往下走。我们下到地铁去。

pages.english: This is the gate. It is made of metal. It has little swinging doors. We tap and pass.
pages.chinese: 这是闸机。它是金属做的。它有小小的摆动门。我们刷卡过去。

pages.english: This is the time. It shows on a screen. The numbers are bright. We check it quickly.
pages.chinese: 这是时间。它显示在屏幕上。数字很亮。我们快速看一眼。

pages.english: These are doors. They are wide and metal. They slide open. We stand back and wait.
pages.chinese: 这些是车门。它们又宽又是金属的。它们滑开。我们退后等着。

pages.english: This is a ticket. It is a small card. It sits in my hand. I tap it at the gate.
pages.chinese: 这是一张车票。它是一张小卡片。它在我手里。我在闸机上刷一下。

pages.english: These are people. They stand in a line. They wait on the platform. They hold their bags.
pages.chinese: 这些是人。他们排成一队。他们在站台等。他们拿着自己的包。

pages.english: This is the tunnel. It is long and dark. It goes under the city. We look out at the lights.
pages.chinese: 这是隧道。它又长又黑。它从城市下面穿过。我们看着外面的灯。

pages.english: This is the subway. It is a long silver train. It runs on the track. It goes very fast.
pages.chinese: 这是地铁。它是一列长长的银色列车。它在轨道上跑。它开得很快。

pages.english: This is my swimsuit. It is pink. It is soft and stretchy. I swim in it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的泳衣。它是粉色的。它又软又有弹性。我穿着它游泳。

pages.english: This is a boat. It is white. It has a flat wooden deck. We row it on the lake.
pages.chinese: 这是一条船。它是白色的。它有一块平平的木甲板。我们在湖上划它。

pages.english: This is a fish. It is silver. It has a quick wiggly tail. It swims under the water. It goes blub, blub.
pages.chinese: 这是一条鱼。它是银色的。它的尾巴摆得很快。它在水下游。它咕噜咕噜吐泡泡。
