pages.english: This is a frog. It is green. It has strong back legs. It sits on the lily pad. It says ribbit, ribbit.
pages.chinese: 这是一只青蛙。它是绿色的。它的后腿很有力。它坐在荷叶上。它呱呱叫。

pages.english: This is the dock. It is made of wood. It has flat boards and posts. We sit on the edge.
pages.chinese: 这是码头。它是木头做的。它有木板和木桩。我们坐在边上。

pages.english: This is a tree. It is tall and green. It has wide leafy arms. We rest in its shade.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵树。它又高又绿。它的枝叶又宽又茂密。我们在它的树荫里休息。

pages.english: This is a rock. It is grey and round. It sits in the water. We skip stones here.
pages.chinese: 这是一块石头。它又灰又圆。它立在水里。我们在这里打水漂。

pages.english: This is the lake. The water is blue and calm. It is all around us. We paddle and play.
pages.chinese: 这是湖。湖水又蓝又静。它把我们围在中间。我们划水、玩耍。

pages.english: This is the fence. It is white. It has short wooden posts. It goes around the yard.
pages.chinese: 这是篱笆。它是白色的。它有一根根短木柱。它围着院子。

pages.english: This is the swing. It is blue. It hangs from the tree. We swing up high.
pages.chinese: 这是秋千。它是蓝色的。它挂在树上。我们荡得很高。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are yellow. Their petals are small and soft. They grow in the bed.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是黄色的。花瓣又小又软。它们长在花坛里。

pages.english: This is the hose. It is green and long. It lies on the grass. We water the plants with it.
pages.chinese: 这是水管。它又绿又长。它放在草地上。我们用它浇花。

pages.english: This is our dog. It is brown. It has a wagging tail. It runs in the grass. It says woof, woof.
pages.chinese: 这是我们的狗。它是棕色的。它摇着尾巴。它在草地上跑。它汪汪叫。

pages.english: This is a ball. It is red and round. It lies on the lawn. We kick it to each other.
pages.chinese: 这是一个球。它又红又圆。它在草坪上。我们互相踢给它。

pages.english: This is a tree. It is big and green. It has wide leaves. It stands at the back.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵树。它又大又绿。它的叶子很宽。它长在后院那头。

pages.english: This is the backyard. The sun is warm. There is grass and a swing. We play here every day.
pages.chinese: 这是后院。太阳暖暖的。这里有草地，也有秋千。我们每天在这里玩。

pages.english: This is the walk. We take small quick steps. We go down the street. We hold hands.
pages.chinese: 这是走路这一段。我们迈着小快步。我们沿着街走。我们手拉手。

pages.english: This is the bus. It is yellow. It has a big long body. It waits at the stop.
pages.chinese: 这是校车。它是黄色的。它的车身又大又长。它停在站上。

pages.english: These are the steps. They are metal. There are three short stairs. We climb up.
pages.chinese: 这是台阶。它们是金属的。有三小级台阶。我们爬上去。

pages.english: This is the window. It is square and clear. It is beside my seat. I wave to mom.
pages.chinese: 这是窗户。它方方的，很干净。它在我座位旁边。我向妈妈挥手。

pages.english: This is the bench. It is long and padded. It goes across the bus. I sit down on it.
pages.chinese: 这是长椅。它又长又软。它横在车里。我坐上去。

pages.english: This is the door. It is wide and folding. It opens and closes. We walk in one by one.
pages.chinese: 这是车门。它又宽又能折起。它开开合合。我们一个一个上去。

pages.english: These are the seats. They are blue and soft. They go all along. We buckle up.
pages.chinese: 这些是座位。它们蓝色的，软软的。它们一路排过去。我们系好安全带。

pages.english: This is the school. It is big and bright. It stands at the end of the street. We run inside.
pages.chinese: 这是学校。它又大又亮。它在街道的尽头。我们跑进去。

pages.english: This is my sweater. It is red. It is made of soft wool. I pull it on Fido.
pages.chinese: 这是我的毛衣。它是红色的。它是软软的毛线做的。我给它穿上。

pages.english: These are my boots. They are yellow. There are four little shoes. Fido stamps around.
pages.chinese: 这是我的靴子。它们是黄色的。有四只小鞋子。它咚咚地走来走去。

pages.english: This is my hat. It is blue. It is small and round. It goes on his head.
pages.chinese: 这是我的帽子。它是蓝色的。它又小又圆。它戴在它头上。

pages.english: This is my scarf. It is red and long. It is soft and warm. I tie it around his neck.
pages.chinese: 这是我的围巾。它又红又长。它又软又暖。我系在它脖子上。

pages.english: This is my other hat. It is green and pointy. It looks funny on him. He wears it well.
pages.chinese: 这是我的另一顶帽子。它是绿色的，尖尖的。它戴在它头上很搞笑。它戴得挺像样。

pages.english: These are my sunglasses. They are dark. They have two little lenses. Fido looks cool in them.
pages.chinese: 这是我的太阳镜。它们是深色的。它们有两片小镜片。它戴上很酷。

pages.english: This is my cape. It is purple. It is long and flowing. It goes on his back.
pages.chinese: 这是我的披风。它是紫色的。它又长又会飘。它披在它背上。

pages.english: This is my mask. It is funny and painted. It covers his face. We laugh at each other.
pages.chinese: 这是我的面具。它很搞笑，上面画着花。它盖住它的脸。我们互相看着笑。

pages.english: This is the farmer. They wear a straw hat. They stand in the orchard. They wave to us.
pages.chinese: 这是农夫。他们戴着草帽。他们站在果园里。他们向我们招手。

pages.english: This is a tree. It is tall and leafy. It is full of red apples. It stands in a row.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵树。它又高，叶子又多。树上挂满了红苹果。它排在树行里。

pages.english: This is a ladder. It is made of wood. It leans on the tree. We climb up to pick.
pages.chinese: 这是一把梯子。它是木头做的。它靠在树上。我们爬上去摘。

pages.english: This is a wagon. It is red. It has a wide flat bed. We fill it with apples.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆小拖车。它是红色的。它有一块宽宽的车板。我们把它装满苹果。

pages.english: This is a tractor. It is green. It has two big back wheels. It stands at the end.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆拖拉机。它是绿色的。它有两个大后轮。它停在果园一头。

pages.english: This is a basket. It is woven and round. I hold it in my hand. I fill it with apples.
pages.chinese: 这是一个篮子。它是编的，圆圆的。我把它提在手里。我用它装苹果。

pages.english: These are my friends. They are smiling. They pick apples too. We work together.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的朋友。他们在笑。他们也在摘苹果。我们一起干活。

pages.english: These are apples. They are red and shiny. They fill the basket. I take a big bite.
pages.chinese: 这些是苹果。它们红红的，亮亮的。它们装满了篮子。我咬了一大口。

pages.english: These are my hangers. They are thin and light. They have little hooks on top. They hang my clothes up.
pages.chinese: 这是我的衣架。它们又细又轻。上面有小钩子。它们把我的衣服挂起来。

pages.english: These are my pants. They are long and blue. They have two straight legs. They hang on a hanger.
pages.chinese: 这是我的长裤。它们又长又蓝。它们有两条直直的裤腿。它们挂在衣架上。

pages.english: These are my shoes. They are small and white. They have two round toes. They sit on the floor.
pages.chinese: 这是我的鞋。它们又小又白。鞋头圆圆的。它们放在地上。

pages.english: These are my blankets. They are soft and warm. They lie folded on the shelf. I snuggle under them.
pages.chinese: 这是我的毯子。它们又软又暖。它们叠好放在架子上。我裹在里面很舒服。

pages.english: These are my shirts. They are colourful. They have short little sleeves. They stand in a row.
pages.chinese: 这是我的短袖。它们五颜六色。它们的袖子短短的。它们排成一排。

pages.english: These are my dresses. They are pretty and long. Their skirts are soft. I twirl around in them.
pages.chinese: 这是我的裙子。它们又漂亮又长。裙摆软软的。我穿着它们转圈。

pages.english: These are my belts. They are long and thin. Each one has a buckle. They hang on a hook.
pages.chinese: 这是我的腰带。它们又长又细。每条都有一个带扣。它们挂在钩子上。

pages.english: This is my closet. It is tall and tidy. All my clothes are inside. I open the door each morning.
pages.chinese: 这是我的衣橱。它又高又整齐。我的衣服都在里面。我每天早上打开门。

pages.english: These are the guests. They are smiling. They come to the door. We say hello.
pages.chinese: 这些是客人。他们在笑。他们来到门口。我们打招呼。

pages.english: These are hats. They are bright paper cones. They sit on our heads. We wear them all day.
pages.chinese: 这些是帽子。它们是鲜艳的纸帽子。它们戴在我们头上。我们戴一整天。

pages.english: This is the cake. It is soft and sweet. It has white frosting on top. We make a wish.
pages.chinese: 这是蛋糕。它又软又甜。上面有白色糖霜。我们许个愿。

pages.english: These are candles. They are small and bright. They stand on the cake. We blow them out.
pages.chinese: 这些是蜡烛。它们又小又亮。它们插在蛋糕上。我们把它们吹灭。

pages.english: These are balloons. They are round and colourful. They float in the air. We hold the strings.
pages.chinese: 这些是气球。它们又圆又彩。它们飘在空中。我们拉着绳子。

pages.english: These are gifts. They are wrapped with paper. They have ribbons on top. I open them one by one.
pages.chinese: 这些是礼物。它们用纸包着。上面系着丝带。我一个个打开。

pages.english: This is the singing. We sing a birthday song. Our voices are loud. Everybody claps.
pages.chinese: 这是大家在唱。我们唱生日歌。我们的声音很响。大家一起拍手。

pages.english: This is the party. There are games and cake. There are friends everywhere. We have a great time.
pages.chinese: 这是派对。有游戏，也有蛋糕。到处是朋友。我们玩得很开心。

pages.english: This is a smile. I give a big smile. It is warm and kind. It makes people happy.
pages.chinese: 这是一个微笑。我笑得很开。它又暖又亲切。它让人开心。

pages.english: This is a pat. I pat my friend softly. My hand is gentle. It says I am here.
pages.chinese: 这是一次轻拍。我轻轻拍朋友。我的手很轻。这表示我在你身边。

pages.english: This is a little gift. It is wrapped with paper. I hand it over. It comes from my heart.
pages.chinese: 这是一份小礼物。它用纸包着。我递过去。它是我真心的。

pages.english: This is a wink. One eye closes and opens. It is quick and funny. It makes us laugh.
pages.chinese: 这是一个眨眼。一只眼闭上又睁开。它又快又逗。它让我们笑。

pages.english: This is a hug. I put my arms around. It is warm and tight. We stay close for a while.
pages.chinese: 这是一个拥抱。我把手臂环起来。它又暖又紧。我们抱一会儿。

pages.english: This is a card. It is made of paper. I draw a heart on it. I give it to a friend.
pages.chinese: 这是一张卡片。它是纸做的。我在上面画一颗心。我送给朋友。

pages.english: This is a kiss. It is soft and quick. I kiss my mom goodnight. She smiles at me.
pages.chinese: 这是一个吻。它又轻又快。我晚上亲妈妈一下。她对我笑。

pages.english: This is a lick. The puppy licks my hand. It is wet and funny. The puppy loves me.
pages.chinese: 这是一舔。小狗舔我的手。它湿湿的，很好笑。小狗喜欢我。

pages.english: This is the stove. It is white. It has four round burners. We cook on it.
pages.chinese: 这是炉子。它是白色的。它有四个圆圆的灶眼。我们在上面做饭。

pages.english: This is the fridge. It is tall and white. It has two big doors. It keeps our food cold.
pages.chinese: 这是冰箱。它又高又白。它有两扇大门。它让食物保持冷。

pages.english: This is the counter. It is made of wood. It is long and flat. We chop here.
pages.chinese: 这是台面。它是木头做的。它又长又平。我们在这里切菜。

pages.english: This is the cookie jar. It is round and clear. It has a lid on top. We open it up.
pages.chinese: 这是饼干罐。它又圆又透明。它上面有一个盖。我们把它打开。

pages.english: This is the sink. It is deep and metal. It sits under the window. We wash dishes in it.
pages.chinese: 这是水槽。它又深又是金属的。它在窗户下面。我们在里面洗碗。

pages.english: This is the cupboard. It is high on the wall. It has two wide doors. Cups and plates go inside.
pages.chinese: 这是橱柜。它在墙上，很高。它有两扇宽门。杯子和盘子放在里面。

pages.english: This is the toaster. It is shiny and small. It has two deep slots. It makes warm toast.
pages.chinese: 这是烤面包机。它亮亮的，小小个。它有两个深深的槽。它能烤热面包。

pages.english: This is the trash can. It is tall and grey. It has a swing lid. We throw things in.
pages.chinese: 这是垃圾桶。它又高又灰。它有一个能翻的盖。我们把东西扔进去。

pages.english: This is my tub. It is white and smooth. It is deep and wide. We fill it with water.
pages.chinese: 这是我的浴缸。它又白又滑。它又深又宽。我们把它放满水。

pages.english: These are my bubbles. They are soft and shiny. They float on the water. I pop them one by one.
pages.chinese: 这是我的泡泡。它们又软又亮。它们浮在水上。我一个一个戳破。

pages.english: This is my soap. It is small and slippery. It sits by the tub. I wash with it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的肥皂。它又小又滑。它放在浴缸边。我用它洗。

pages.english: This is my towel. It is soft and fluffy. It hangs on the hook. I dry myself with it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的毛巾。它又软又蓬松。它挂在钩子上。我用它擦干。

pages.english: This is the water. It is warm and clear. It fills the tub. I splash about.
pages.chinese: 这是水。它又暖又清。它装满浴缸。我在里面拍水。

pages.english: These are my toys. There is a duck and a boat. They float on the water. I play with them.
pages.chinese: 这是我的玩具。有一只鸭子和一条船。它们浮在水上。我和它们玩。

pages.english: This is my shampoo. It is thick and sweet. It comes in a bottle. We wash my hair with it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的洗发水。它又稠又香。它装在瓶子里。我们用它洗我的头发。

pages.english: This is my bath. The water is warm. There are bubbles everywhere. Now I am clean.
pages.chinese: 这是我的洗澡时间。水暖暖的。到处都是泡泡。现在我洗干净了。

pages.english: These are blocks. They are square and colourful. They lie on the floor. I stack them up.
pages.chinese: 这些是积木。它们方方的，五颜六色。它们放在地上。我把它们摞起来。

pages.english: This is paint. It is bright and wet. It sits in little pots. I paint a picture.
pages.chinese: 这是颜料。它又亮又湿。它装在小罐里。我画一幅画。

pages.english: This is a plane. It is white. It has two straight wings. I fly it around.
pages.chinese: 这是一架飞机。它是白色的。它有两片直翅膀。我举着它飞。

pages.english: This is a kite. It is blue. It has a long tail behind. It flies in the wind.
pages.chinese: 这是一个风筝。它是蓝色的。它后面拖着长尾巴。它在风里飞。

pages.english: This is a bear. It is soft and brown. It has fluffy round ears. I hug it at night.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小熊。它又软又棕。它有毛茸茸的圆耳朵。我晚上抱着它。

pages.english: This is a drum. It is red. It has a round tight top. I tap it with my hands.
pages.chinese: 这是一个鼓。它是红色的。它有一个绷紧的圆面。我用手拍它。

pages.english: This is a wagon. It is red. It has four small wheels. I pull it along.
pages.chinese: 这是小拖车。它是红色的。它有四个小轮子。我拉着它走。

pages.english: This is a robot. It is silver. It has two stiff arms. I press the button.
pages.chinese: 这是一个机器人。它是银色的。它有两条僵硬的胳膊。我按下按钮。

pages.english: We draw a plan. The pencil is on the paper. We make lines and shapes. This is the first step.
pages.chinese: 我们画一张图。铅笔在纸上。我们画线和形状。这是第一步。

pages.english: We sand the wood. The paper is rough. We rub it back and forth. Now it is smooth.
pages.chinese: 我们把木头磨平。砂纸粗粗的。我们来来回回地擦。现在它光滑了。

pages.english: We drill a hole. The drill goes round and round. The wood is soft inside. Now the hole is deep.
pages.chinese: 我们钻一个洞。钻头转呀转。木头里面软软的。现在洞够深了。

pages.english: We glue the pieces. The glue is wet and clear. We press them together. Now they stay.
pages.chinese: 我们把木块粘起来。胶水湿湿的、透明的。我们用力压一压。现在它们粘住了。

pages.english: We saw the board. The saw goes back and forth. Small dust falls down. Now the board is short.
pages.chinese: 我们锯木板。锯子来回拉。木屑往下掉。现在木板短了。

pages.english: We hammer the nails. We tap, tap, tap. The nails go in deep. Now it is strong.
pages.chinese: 我们钉钉子。我们敲呀敲。钉子钉进去了。现在很结实了。

pages.english: We paint it blue. The brush goes up and down. The colour is bright. Now it looks new.
pages.chinese: 我们把它刷成蓝色。刷子上下刷。颜色很亮。现在它像新的一样。

pages.english: We hang it up. It is high on the wall. We stand back and look. Look what we made!
pages.chinese: 我们把它挂起来。它挂在墙上高处。我们退后看一看。看我们做的东西！

pages.english: Our drive is long. The car rolls on and on. We look out the window. Trees go by fast.
pages.chinese: 我们开车要开很久。车子一直往前滚。我们看着窗外。树飞快地过去。

pages.english: Our tools are ready. There is a torch and a rope. They sit in the boot. We carry them out.
pages.chinese: 我们的工具准备好了。有手电筒，也有绳子。它们放在车尾箱。我们把它们搬出来。

pages.english: Our fire is warm. The flames go up high. It goes crackle, crackle. We sit around it.
pages.chinese: 我们的火很暖。火苗窜得很高。它噼啪作响。我们围坐在旁边。

pages.english: Our stories are funny. We tell them in the dark. Everybody laughs. The night is cosy.
pages.chinese: 我们的故事很好笑。我们在黑天里讲。大家都笑。夜里暖暖的。

pages.english: Our spot is quiet. The ground is flat. Tall trees stand around. We stop here.
pages.chinese: 我们选的地方很安静。地面平平的。四周有高高的树。我们在这里停下。

pages.english: Our tent is green. It is small but dry. We zip it up tight. We sleep inside.
pages.chinese: 我们的帐篷是绿色的。它不大，但很干。我们把拉链拉紧。我们在里面睡觉。

pages.english: Our food smells good. It is hot and tasty. We cook it on the fire. We eat outside.
pages.chinese: 我们的食物很香。它又热又好吃。我们在火上做。我们在外面吃。

pages.english: Our camp is cosy. The stars are above us. The fire is still warm. We sleep well here.
pages.chinese: 我们的营地很舒服。星星在我们头顶。火还暖着。我们在这里睡得香。

pages.english: These are my friends. They are smiling. They come to help. We build together.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的朋友。他们在笑。他们来帮忙。我们一起搭。

pages.english: These are pillows. They are soft and squishy. They lie on the floor. We pile them up.
pages.chinese: 这些是枕头。它们又软又能压扁。它们放在地上。我们把它们堆起来。

pages.english: This is food. It sits in a bowl. There are little snacks. We eat inside the fort.
pages.chinese: 这是食物。它装在碗里。有一些小零食。我们在堡垒里吃。

pages.english: These are lights. They are small and bright. They shine in the dark. We switch them on.
pages.chinese: 这些是灯。它们又小又亮。它们在黑里发光。我们把它们打开。

pages.english: These are chairs. They are small and low. They stand by the wall. We line them up.
pages.chinese: 这些是椅子。它们又小又矮。它们靠墙摆着。我们把它们排好。

pages.english: These are blankets. They are wide and soft. They go over the chairs. Now it looks like a tent.
pages.chinese: 这些是毯子。它们又宽又软。它们盖在椅子上。现在它像个帐篷了。

pages.english: These are games. There are cards and boards. They lie on the floor. We play them inside.
pages.chinese: 这些是游戏。有卡片，也有棋盘。它们放在地上。我们在里面玩。

pages.english: This is the fort. It is made of pillows. It is cosy and dark. We hide inside it.
pages.chinese: 这是堡垒。它是枕头搭的。它又舒服又暗。我们躲在里面。

pages.english: This is my shovel. It is small and metal. It has a wide flat head. I dig with it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的铲子。它小小个，是金属的。它有一个宽宽的铲头。我用它挖土。

pages.english: This is my hoe. It is long with a flat blade. It leans by the row. I loosen the soil.
pages.chinese: 这是我的锄头。它长长的，有一个扁扁的刃。它靠在田垄边。我用它松土。

pages.english: These are my seeds. They are small and brown. They sit in a packet. I put them in the soil.
pages.chinese: 这是我的种子。它们又小又棕。它们装在纸袋里。我把它们放进土里。

pages.english: These are my plants. They are green. They have soft little leaves. They grow in the soil.
pages.chinese: 这是我的植物。它们是绿色的。它们有软软的小叶子。它们在土里生长。

pages.english: This is my soil. It is dark and damp. It is soft between my fingers. I pat it down.
pages.chinese: 这是我的土。它又黑又潮。捏在指间软软的。我把它压平。

pages.english: These are my rows. They are long and straight. They go across the bed. I walk between them.
pages.chinese: 这是我的田垄。它们又长又直。它们横过整块地。我在它们中间走。

pages.english: This is my hose. It is green and long. It lies on the ground. I water everything.
pages.chinese: 这是我的水管。它又绿又长。它放在地上。我给所有植物浇水。

pages.english: This is my garden. The plants stand in neat rows. The leaves are green and fresh. I grow things here.
pages.chinese: 这是我的花园。植物排得整整齐齐。叶子又绿又新鲜。我在这里种东西。

pages.english: This is the cover. It is bright and flat. It shows a picture. I hold the book by it.
pages.chinese: 这是封面。它又亮又平。它上面有一幅画。我扶着它拿书。

pages.english: This is the title. It is big and clear. It sits at the top. We read it out loud.
pages.chinese: 这是书名。它又大又清楚。它在最上面。我们大声念出来。

pages.english: These are the words. They are small and black. They go across the page. I point at them.
pages.chinese: 这些是文字。它们又小又黑。它们一行行走过页面。我指着它们。

pages.english: This is the page number. It is a little digit. It sits in the corner. It helps us find our place.
pages.chinese: 这是页码。它是一个小数字。它在页角。它帮我们找到读到哪里。

pages.english: This is the back cover. It is soft and plain. It comes at the end. I turn the book over.
pages.chinese: 这是封底。它软软的，很素净。它在最后面。我把书翻过来。

pages.english: These are the pages. They are thin and light. They turn one by one. I turn them slowly.
pages.chinese: 这些是书页。它们又薄又轻。它们一页页翻过去。我慢慢翻。

pages.english: These are the letters. They are small signs. They sit side by side. Letters make words.
pages.chinese: 这些是字母。它们是小符号。它们一个挨一个。字母组成单词。

pages.english: This is the book. It has words and pictures. It is lovely and warm. We read it again and again.
pages.chinese: 这是一本书。它有文字，也有图画。它可亲又温暖。我们一遍又一遍地读。

pages.english: This is my dress. It is yellow. It has a soft frilly skirt. I twirl around in it.
pages.chinese: 这是我的裙子。它是黄色的。它的裙摆软软的，有花边。我穿着它转圈。

pages.english: This is my basket. It is woven and round. I hold it in my hand. I fill it with eggs.
pages.chinese: 这是我的篮子。它是编的，圆圆的。我把它提在手里。我用它装彩蛋。

pages.english: This is my candy. It is bright and sweet. It has a shiny wrapper. I eat one slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是我的糖。它又亮又甜。它包着亮亮的糖纸。我慢慢吃一颗。

pages.english: This is my family. They are kind and smiling. They stand all around me. We hug each other.
pages.chinese: 这是我的家人。他们很和善，一直在笑。他们围在我身边。我们互相拥抱。

pages.english: This is my hat. It is white. It has a wide soft brim. I wear it outside.
pages.chinese: 这是我的帽子。它是白色的。它有一个又宽又软的帽檐。我戴着它出门。

pages.english: These are the eggs. They are colourful. We paint them bright. They hide in the grass.
pages.chinese: 这些是彩蛋。它们五颜六色。我们把它们画得很鲜艳。它们藏在草里。

pages.english: These are the flowers. They are spring colours. Their petals are open. They grow in the garden.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们是春天的颜色。花瓣都开着。它们长在花园里。

pages.english: This is Easter. There are eggs and flowers. The whole family is here. We celebrate together.
pages.chinese: 这是复活节。有彩蛋，也有花。一家人都在一起。我们一起庆祝。

pages.english: This is her voice. It is soft and low. It sounds like home. I hear it every day.
pages.chinese: 这是她的声音。它又柔又低。听起来就像家。我每天都听。

pages.english: This is her hug. Two arms go around me. It is warm and tight. I feel safe in it.
pages.chinese: 这是她的拥抱。两条手臂把我围起来。它又暖又紧。我在里面很安心。

pages.english: This is her smile. It is wide and bright. It makes me smile too. I love her smile.
pages.chinese: 这是她的笑。它又大又亮。它让我也笑起来。我喜欢她的笑。

pages.english: This is her tuck. She pulls the blanket up. It comes to my chin. Then she says goodnight.
pages.chinese: 这是她给我盖被子。她把被子往上拉。被子盖到我下巴。然后她说晚安。

pages.english: This is her help. She shows me how to do it. Her hands move slowly. Then I can do it too.
pages.chinese: 这是她在帮我。她教我怎么做好。她的手慢慢示范。然后我也会了。

pages.english: This is her wave. Her arm goes up high. She waves at the gate. I wave back.
pages.chinese: 这是她挥手。她的手举得高高的。她在门口挥手。我也挥手。

pages.english: These are her eyes. They are bright and kind. They look right at me. They see when I am sad.
pages.chinese: 这是她的眼睛。它们又亮又温和。它们直视着我。我难过的时候她看得出来。

pages.english: This is her love. It is quiet and warm. It stays with me all day. I love my mom.
pages.chinese: 这是她的爱。它安安静静，暖暖的。它一整天都陪着我。我爱我妈妈。

pages.english: This is the line. People stand in it. They wait at the counter. The line moves slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是队伍。人们排在里面。他们在柜台前等。队伍慢慢往前。

pages.english: This is the door. It is wide and dark. It stands at the end. We walk in together.
pages.chinese: 这是门。它又宽又暗。它在走廊尽头。我们一起走进去。

pages.english: This is popcorn. It is warm and light. It fills a big tub. We share it.
pages.chinese: 这是爆米花。它又热又轻。它装了一大桶。我们分着吃。

pages.english: This is the dark. The lights are all off. It is black all around. I hold mom's hand.
pages.chinese: 这是黑暗。灯全关了。四周黑黑的。我拉着妈妈的手。

pages.english: These are the tickets. There are two small slips. I hold them in my hand. We show them at the door.
pages.chinese: 这些是票。有两张小票。我把它们拿在手里。我们在门口出示。

pages.english: These are the seats. They are soft and tall. They stand in rows. We sit back and wait.
pages.chinese: 这些是座位。它们又软又高。它们一排排的。我们靠好等着。

pages.english: This is the screen. It is huge and bright. It shows a story. We watch it closely.
pages.chinese: 这是屏幕。它又大又亮。它在讲故事。我们看得入神。

pages.english: This is the movie. It is funny and loud. It goes on for a long time. We enjoy every minute.
pages.chinese: 这是电影。它又好笑又热闹。它放了好久。我们每一分钟都很享受。

pages.english: This is my mother. She has warm hands. She holds me close. I love her.
pages.chinese: 这是我的妈妈。她的手暖暖的。她把我抱得紧紧的。我爱她。

pages.english: This is my brother. He is tall and funny. He plays with me. We laugh a lot.
pages.chinese: 这是我的哥哥。他又高又好笑。他和我一起玩。我们常常大笑。

pages.english: This is my grandfather. He has a soft voice. He tells me stories. I sit on his lap.
pages.chinese: 这是我的爷爷。他的声音很温和。他给我讲故事。我坐在他腿上。

pages.english: This is me. I am small and happy. I have two little hands. I am part of this family.
pages.chinese: 这是我。我又小又开心。我有两只小手。我是这个家的一员。

pages.english: This is my father. He is strong and kind. He carries me up high. I laugh in the air.
pages.chinese: 这是我的爸爸。他又强壮又和善。他把我举得高高的。我在空中笑。

pages.english: This is my sister. She is gentle and sweet. She shares her toys. I follow her around.
pages.chinese: 这是我的姐姐。她又温柔又贴心。她把玩具分给我。我跟着她到处走。

pages.english: This is my grandmother. She cooks nice food. Her kitchen smells warm. She smiles when we eat.
pages.chinese: 这是我的奶奶。她做的饭很好吃。她的厨房总是香香的。我们吃的时候她一直笑。

pages.english: This is my family. We are all together. Some are big and some are small. We take care of each other.
pages.chinese: 这是我的家。我们在一起。有的大，有的小。我们互相关照。

pages.english: This is a story. It is a bedtime story. We read one more page. Then the book closes.
pages.chinese: 这是一个故事。它是睡前故事。我们又多读一页。然后书合上了。

pages.english: This is my pillow. It is soft and white. I fluff it up. Then I lie down.
pages.chinese: 这是我的枕头。它又软又白。我把它拍松。然后我躺下。

pages.english: This is my blanket. It is warm and thick. It comes up to my chin. I feel cosy.
pages.chinese: 这是我的毯子。它又暖又厚。它盖到我下巴。我觉得很舒服。

pages.english: This is the moon. It is round and bright. It peeks in the window. It says goodnight too.
pages.chinese: 这是月亮。它又圆又亮。它从窗户探进来。它也说着晚安。

pages.english: This is my bed. It is small and warm. It sits by the wall. I sleep here every night.
pages.chinese: 这是我的床。它又小又暖。它靠墙放。我每晚睡在这里。

pages.english: This is my bear. It is soft and brown. I hug it tight. It sleeps with me.
pages.chinese: 这是我的小熊。它又软又棕。我紧紧抱着它。它和我一起睡。

pages.english: This is a kiss. It is soft on my forehead. Mom kisses me goodnight. Then she turns off the light.
pages.chinese: 这是一个吻。它轻轻落在我额头上。妈妈亲我，说晚安。然后她关灯。

pages.english: This is my dream. It is sweet and quiet. I close my eyes. See you in the morning.
pages.chinese: 这是我的梦。它又甜又安静。我闭上眼睛。早上见。

pages.english: This is a funny hat. It is tall and silly. It wobbles on his head. We laugh at it.
pages.chinese: 这是一顶好笑的帽子。它又高又滑稽。它在它头上摇来摇去。我们看着就笑。

pages.english: This is a funny bow. It is big and spotty. It sits by his chin. It looks too big.
pages.chinese: 这是一个好笑的蝴蝶结。它又大又有圆点。它卡在它下巴旁边。它看起来太大了。

pages.english: These are funny pants. They are baggy with zigzags. They swish when he walks. They are much too long.
pages.chinese: 这是一条好笑的裤子。它们又宽又有锯齿花纹。它走动时哗啦哗啦。它们太长了。

pages.english: These are funny glasses. They are round and big. They sit on his nose. His eyes look huge.
pages.chinese: 这是一副好笑的眼镜。它们又圆又大。它们架在它鼻子上。它的眼睛看起来好大。

pages.english: This is a funny shirt. It has flowers all over. It is too big on him. The sleeves hang down.
pages.chinese: 这是一件好笑的衬衫。上面全是花。它穿在它身上太大了。袖子垂下来。

pages.english: This is a funny tie. It is long and spotted. It hangs down low. It touches the floor.
pages.chinese: 这是一条好笑的领带。它又长又有斑点。它垂得很低。它都拖到地上了。

pages.english: These are funny boots. They are red and curly. They squeak as he steps. He clomps around.
pages.chinese: 这是一双好笑的靴子。它们又红又卷。它走一步就吱一声。它咚咚地走。

pages.english: This is the funny cat. It wears silly clothes. It walks with its chin up. It makes us laugh.
pages.chinese: 这就是那只滑稽的猫。它穿着滑稽的衣服。它抬着下巴走路。它让我们笑个不停。

pages.english: This is a big house. It is blue. It has a wide roof. It stands on the hill.
pages.chinese: 这是一座大房子。它是蓝色的。它有一个宽宽的屋顶。它立在小山上。

pages.english: This is a big car. It is red. It has four big wheels. It sits in the drive.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆大汽车。它是红色的。它有四个大轮子。它停在车道上。

pages.english: This is a big airplane. It is white. It has two long wings. It flies high in the sky.
pages.chinese: 这是一架大飞机。它是白色的。它有两片长翅膀。它在高高的天上飞。

pages.english: This is a big elephant. It is grey. It has a long trunk. It walks in the grass.
pages.chinese: 这是一头大象。它是灰色的。它有一个长鼻子。它在草里走。

pages.english: This is a big dog. It is brown. It has two round ears. It waits by the gate. It says woof, woof.
pages.chinese: 这是一只大狗。它是棕色的。它有两只圆耳朵。它在门口等。它汪汪叫。

pages.english: This is a big bus. It is yellow. It has many windows. It goes down the road.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆大巴士。它是黄色的。它有很多窗户。它在马路上开。

pages.english: This is a big tree. It is green. It has wide leafy arms. It stands in the yard.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵大树。它是绿色的。它的枝叶又宽又茂盛。它立在院子里。

pages.english: This is a big dinosaur. It is green. It has a very long neck. It fills the whole picture.
pages.chinese: 这是一只大恐龙。它是绿色的。它的脖子非常长。它占满了整幅画。

pages.english: This is a little house. It is white. It has a small red door. It sits in the snow.
pages.chinese: 这是一座小房子。它是白色的。它有一扇小红门。它在雪地里。

pages.english: This is a little car. It is blue. It has four tiny wheels. It waits on the path.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆小汽车。它是蓝色的。它有四个小小的轮子。它停在小路上。

pages.english: This is a little tree. It is green. It has thin little branches. It grows in a pot.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵小树。它是绿色的。它的枝条又细又小。它长在花盆里。

pages.english: This is a little mouse. It is grey. It has two round ears. It runs by the wall. It says squeak, squeak.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小老鼠。它是灰色的。它有两只圆耳朵。它沿着墙跑。它吱吱叫。

pages.english: This is a little dog. It is brown. It has a wagging tail. It sits on the rug. It says woof, woof.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小狗。它是棕色的。它摇着尾巴。它坐在地毯上。它汪汪叫。

pages.english: This is a little airplane. It is white. It has two short wings. It flies in the sky.
pages.chinese: 这是一架小飞机。它是白色的。它有两片短翅膀。它在天上飞。

pages.english: This is a little bug. It is red. It has tiny little legs. It sits on a leaf.
pages.chinese: 这是一只小虫。它是红色的。它有小小的腿。它停在叶子上。

pages.english: This is a little baby. It is small and soft. It has two soft cheeks. It sleeps in the crib.
pages.chinese: 这是一个小宝宝。它又小又软。它有两个软软的脸蛋。它睡在小床里。

pages.english: This is a chair. A little cat hides under it. The cat is black and white. Only its tail shows.
pages.chinese: 这是一把椅子。一只小猫藏在下面。这只猫是黑白色的。只露出尾巴。

pages.english: This is a table. Two feet peek out under it. Somebody is hiding there. The floor is cool and dark.
pages.chinese: 这是一张桌子。两只脚从下面露出来。有人藏在下面。地板又凉又暗。

pages.english: This is a pillow. Something small sleeps under it. It is soft and warm there. We hear a little sound.
pages.chinese: 这是一个枕头。有个小东西在下面睡。那里又软又暖。我们听到一点声音。

pages.english: This is a swing. The grass grows under it. It is cool and dark down there. Our shadows fall under it.
pages.chinese: 这是秋千。秋千下面长着草。下面又凉又暗。我们的影子落在下面。

pages.english: This is a desk. A toy waits under it. It is small and round. We bend down to see.
pages.chinese: 这是一张书桌。一个玩具在下面等着。它又小又圆。我们弯下腰去看。

pages.english: This is a bed. Dust hides under it. It is dark down there. The broom reaches it.
pages.chinese: 这是一张床。灰尘藏在下面。下面黑黑的。扫把能伸到那里。

pages.english: This is an umbrella. We stand under it. The rain falls all around. We stay nice and dry.
pages.chinese: 这是一把雨伞。我们站在下面。雨在四周落下来。我们身上干干的。

pages.english: This is a tree. We sit under it. The leaves make cool shade. The grass is soft below.
pages.chinese: 这是一棵树。我们坐在树下。树叶投下凉凉的阴影。下面的草软软的。

pages.english: This is the roof. A bird sits on it. The bird is small and brown. It looks all around.
pages.chinese: 这是屋顶。一只鸟停在上面。这只鸟又小又棕。它四处看。

pages.english: This is a swing. A girl sits on it. She goes up and down. She holds the ropes tight.
pages.chinese: 这是秋千。一个女孩坐在上面。她上上下下地荡。她抓紧绳子。

pages.english: This is an airplane. We sit on it. It flies above the clouds. Everything looks tiny.
pages.chinese: 这是一架飞机。我们坐在上面。它飞在云上。所有东西都变得小小的。

pages.english: This is a table. A warm cup sits on it. The steam goes up. We wait for it to cool.
pages.chinese: 这是一张桌子。一个热杯子放在上面。热气往上冒。我们等它凉一点。

pages.english: This is a bike. A boy rides on it. He goes down the path. The wheels turn fast.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆自行车。一个男孩骑在上面。他沿着小路骑。轮子转得很快。

pages.english: This is a bed. A soft bear lies on it. It does not move at all. It waits for bedtime.
pages.chinese: 这是一张床。一只小熊躺在上面。它一动不动。它等着睡觉时间。

pages.english: This is a fence. A cat walks on the top. It steps very carefully. Its tail goes up high.
pages.chinese: 这是篱笆。一只猫走在上面。它走得很小心。它的尾巴竖得高高的。

pages.english: These are skates. Two feet roll on them. The wheels hum on the path. We go fast and far.
pages.chinese: 这是溜冰鞋。两只脚在上面滑。轮子在小路上嗡嗡响。我们滑得又快又远。

pages.english: This is a car. We sit in it. There are seats and a window. We drive away.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆汽车。我们坐在里面。里面有座位，也有窗户。我们开车出发。

pages.english: This is a boat. We sit in it. It rocks on the water. We hold on tight.
pages.chinese: 这是一条船。我们坐在里面。它在水面上摇。我们抓稳了。

pages.english: This is water. Fish swim in it. The water is cool and clear. They move all around.
pages.chinese: 这是水。鱼在水里游。水又凉又清。它们四处游动。

pages.english: This is mud. Our boots go in it. It is soft and squishy. We hear a squelch.
pages.chinese: 这是泥。我们的靴子踩进去。它又软又会挤出水。我们听到咕叽一声。

pages.english: This is a wagon. Apples roll in it. They are red and round. We pull the wagon along.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆小拖车。苹果在里面滚。它们又红又圆。我们拉着车走。

pages.english: This is a house. We live in it. It is warm and dry. Our beds are inside.
pages.chinese: 这是一座房子。我们住在里面。它又暖又干。我们的床在里面。

pages.english: This is grass. Something hides in it. The grass is tall and green. We part it with our hands.
pages.chinese: 这是草。有个东西藏在里面。草又高又绿。我们用手把草拨开。

pages.english: This is a bathtub. I sit in it. There are bubbles everywhere. The water is warm.
pages.chinese: 这是一个浴缸。我坐在里面。到处都是泡泡。水暖暖的。

pages.english: This is a car. We step out of it. The sun is warm outside. We stretch our arms.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆汽车。我们从车里出来。外面的太阳暖暖的。我们伸伸胳膊。

pages.english: This is a boat. We step out of it. Our feet land on the dock. The boat rocks behind us.
pages.chinese: 这是一条船。我们从船上下来。我们的脚落在码头上。船在我们身后摇。

pages.english: This is water. Something comes out of it. It is dripping wet. It shakes itself dry.
pages.chinese: 这是水。有个东西从水里出来。它湿淋淋地滴水。它甩甩身子。

pages.english: This is mud. Our boots come out of it. They are heavy and brown. We stamp them clean.
pages.chinese: 这是泥。我们的靴子从泥里拔出来。它们又重又棕。我们跺跺脚把泥甩掉。

pages.english: This is a wagon. We lift the apples out. They roll into the basket. The wagon is empty now.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆小拖车。我们把苹果拿出来。它们滚进篮子里。车现在空了。

pages.english: This is a house. We run out of it. The yard is bright and open. We play in the sun.
pages.chinese: 这是一座房子。我们从屋里跑出去。院子又亮又开阔。我们在太阳下玩。

pages.english: This is grass. A ball rolls out of it. It is red and round. We run after it.
pages.chinese: 这是草。一个球从草里滚出来。它又红又圆。我们追着它跑。

pages.english: This is a bathtub. I climb out of it. I am warm and clean. Mom wraps me in a towel.
pages.chinese: 这是一个浴缸。我从浴缸里出来。我身上又暖又干净。妈妈用毛巾把我裹起来。

pages.english: This is a bed. My feet come off it. They find the cool floor. The day starts now.
pages.chinese: 这是一张床。我的脚从床上下来。它们碰到凉凉的地板。新的一天开始了。

pages.english: This is a table. A cup is lifted off it. It is warm in my hands. The table looks empty.
pages.chinese: 这是一张桌子。一个杯子从桌上被拿走。捧在我手里暖暖的。桌子看起来空了。

pages.english: This is a computer. The screen goes off. The light fades away. The room is quiet now.
pages.chinese: 这是一台电脑。屏幕关掉了。光慢慢消失。房间现在很安静。

pages.english: This is a step. One hop and I am off it. My feet hit the ground. I land with a thump.
pages.chinese: 这是一级台阶。我一跳就下来了。我的脚落到地上。我咚的一声落地。

pages.english: This is a couch. The cat jumps off it. It lands very softly. Then it walks away.
pages.chinese: 这是一张沙发。猫从沙发上跳下来。它轻轻落地。然后它走开了。

pages.english: This is a chair. A little one slides off it. The chair is empty now. The seat is still warm.
pages.chinese: 这是一把椅子。一个小家伙从椅子上滑下来。椅子现在空了。座位还留着温度。

pages.english: This is a towel. It comes off the hook. It is soft and dry. We wipe our hands.
pages.chinese: 这是一条毛巾。它从钩子上被拿下来。它又软又干。我们擦手。

pages.english: This is a car. We step off it. We wave goodbye. The car drives away.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆汽车。我们从车上下来。我们挥手说再见。车子开走了。

pages.english: This is a log. We jump over it. Our feet leave the ground. Then we land on the other side.
pages.chinese: 这是一根木头。我们跳过它。我们的脚离开地面。然后落在另一边。

pages.english: This is a hole. We hop over it. The hole is small and round. We do not fall in.
pages.chinese: 这是一个洞。我们单脚跳过它。洞又小又圆。我们没有掉进去。

pages.english: This is a bat. The ball flies over it. It goes high in the air. We watch it go.
pages.chinese: 这是一根球棒。球飞过它。它飞得高高。我们看着它飞走。

pages.english: This is a doll. A toy sails over it. It lands on the bed. The doll does not move.
pages.chinese: 这是一个娃娃。一个玩具从它上方飞过。它落在床上。娃娃一动没动。

pages.english: This is a pot. Up and over it goes. The plant shakes a little. Then all is still.
pages.chinese: 这是一个花盆。它飞上去，越过去。植物轻轻晃了晃。然后一切都静止了。

pages.english: This is a bike. We leap over the wheel. It looks very high. We land safe and sound.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆自行车。我们跃过轮子。它看起来很高。我们稳稳落地。

pages.english: This is a ball. A bird swoops over it. Its wings go whoosh. Then it is gone.
pages.chinese: 这是一个球。一只鸟从它上方掠过。它的翅膀呼的一声。然后它飞走了。

pages.english: This is a cat. Something jumps right over it. The cat looks up. Then it goes back to sleep.
pages.chinese: 这是一只猫。有个东西从它身上跳过去。猫抬头看。然后它又睡了。

pages.english: These are the farmers. They wear straw hats. They stand behind the stalls. They smile at us.
pages.chinese: 这些是农民。他们戴着草帽。他们站在摊位后面。他们对我们笑。

pages.english: These are vegetables. They are green and fresh. They lie in wooden boxes. We pick some.
pages.chinese: 这些是蔬菜。它们绿绿的，很新鲜。它们放在木箱里。我们挑一些。

pages.english: These are flowers. They are bright. They stand in tall buckets. We choose a bunch.
pages.chinese: 这些是花。它们很鲜艳。它们插在高高的桶里。我们挑一束。

pages.english: These are cookies. They are warm and golden. They lie on a tray. We buy a small bag.
pages.chinese: 这些是饼干。它们热乎乎的，金灿灿的。它们放在托盘上。我们买一小袋。

pages.english: These are tents. They are white. They have wide canvas roofs. They cover every stall.
pages.chinese: 这些是帐篷。它们是白色的。它们有宽宽的帆布顶。它们盖住每个摊位。

pages.english: This is fruit. It is juicy and colourful. It sits in little baskets. We taste a piece.
pages.chinese: 这是水果。它多汁又鲜艳。它装在小篮子里。我们尝一块。

pages.english: This is jam. It is sweet and red. It comes in glass jars. We take one home.
pages.chinese: 这是果酱。它又甜又红。它装在玻璃罐里。我们带一罐回家。

pages.english: This is the market. It is busy and loud. There are people and stalls. We look and buy.
pages.chinese: 这是集市。它又热闹又吵。有人，也有摊位。我们边看边买。

pages.english: This box is big. That box is small. They sit side by side. Big and small are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这个盒子很大。那个盒子很小。它们放在一起。大和小是反义词。

pages.english: This towel is wet. That shirt is dry. Water is on the towel. Wet and dry are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这条毛巾是湿的。那件衣服是干的。毛巾上有水。湿和干是反义词。

pages.english: This soup is hot. That ice is cold. Steam comes from the soup. Hot and cold are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这碗汤是热的。那块冰是冷的。汤上有热气。热和冷是反义词。

pages.english: This board is flat. That ball is round. The board lies still. Flat and round are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这块板子是平的。那个球是圆的。板子平平地放着。平和圆是反义词。

pages.english: This cup is small. That cup is big. Both hold water. Small and big are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这个杯子很小。那个杯子很大。两个都能装水。小和大是反义词。

pages.english: This sand is dry. That mud is wet. The sand slips through my fingers. Dry and wet are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这些沙子是干的。那片泥是湿的。沙子从指缝溜走。干和湿是反义词。

pages.english: This ice is cold. That soup is hot. My hands feel both. Cold and hot are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这块冰是冷的。那碗汤是热的。我的手两种都摸到了。冷和热是反义词。

pages.english: This ball is round. That box is flat. The ball rolls away. Round and flat are opposites.
pages.chinese: 这个球是圆的。那个盒子是平的。球滚走了。圆和平是反义词。

pages.english: These are balloons. They are round and colourful. They hang on the wall. We hold the strings.
pages.chinese: 这些是气球。它们又圆又彩。它们挂在墙上。我们拉着绳子。

pages.english: These are hats. They are bright paper cones. They sit on our heads. We wear them all day.
pages.chinese: 这些是帽子。它们是鲜艳的纸帽子。它们戴在我们头上。我们戴一整天。

pages.english: These are games. There are balls and music. We play in the yard. Everybody runs and laughs.
pages.chinese: 这些是游戏。有球，也有音乐。我们在院子里玩。大家又跑又笑。

pages.english: This is the cake. It is soft and sweet. It has frosting on top. We cut it into pieces.
pages.chinese: 这是蛋糕。它又软又甜。上面有糖霜。我们把它切成一块块。

pages.english: These are candles. They are bright and small. They stand on the cake. We make a wish.
pages.chinese: 这些是蜡烛。它们又亮又小。它们插在蛋糕上。我们许个愿。

pages.english: This is ice cream. It is cold and sweet. It comes in a round scoop. I lick it slowly.
pages.chinese: 这是冰激凌。它又冷又甜。它是一勺圆圆的球。我慢慢舔。

pages.english: These are gifts. They are wrapped with paper. They have ribbons on top. I open them one by one.
pages.chinese: 这些是礼物。它们用纸包着。上面系着丝带。我一个个打开。

pages.english: These are my friends. They are smiling at me. They sing the birthday song. We are happy together.
pages.chinese: 这些是我的朋友。他们对着我笑。他们唱生日歌。我们在一起很开心。

pages.english: This is a taxi. It is yellow. It has a little sign on top. It stops for people.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆出租车。它是黄色的。它顶上有一个小牌子。它停下来接人。

pages.english: This is a stop light. It has three round lamps. It hangs at the corner. Red means stop.
pages.chinese: 这是交通灯。它有三个圆灯。它挂在转角处。红灯表示停。

pages.english: This is a car. It is small and bright. It drives in the lane. It waits for the light.
pages.chinese: 这是一辆汽车。它又小又亮。它在车道里开。它等灯变绿。

pages.english: This is a building. It is very tall. Its windows are high above. It stands at the corner.
pages.chinese: 这是一栋楼。它非常高。窗户在很高处。它立在街角。

pages.english: These are people. They walk this way and that. They carry bags and phones. The sidewalk is full.
pages.chinese: 这些是人。他们往这边走，往那边走。他们拿着包和手机。人行道上全是人。

pages.english: This is the sidewalk. It is grey and flat. It runs by the shops. We walk on it.
pages.chinese: 这是人行道。它又灰又平。它沿着商店延伸。我们在上面走。

pages.english: This is a stop sign. It is red. It has eight straight sides. Cars stop here.
pages.chinese: 这是停车标志。它是红色的。它有八条直边。汽车在这里停。

pages.english: This is a street sign. It is green. It has white letters on it. It stands on a pole.
pages.chinese: 这是一个路牌。它是绿色的。上面有白色的字。它立在杆子上。

pages.english: This is a ballerina. She wears a pink skirt. It is soft and floaty. She stands on her toes.
pages.chinese: 这是一位芭蕾舞演员。她穿着粉色的裙子。裙子又软又会飘。她用脚尖站立。

pages.english: This is a chef. They wear a tall white hat. They work in the kitchen. They cook our food.
pages.chinese: 这是一位厨师。戴着高高的白帽子。他们在厨房工作。他们做饭给我们吃。

pages.english: This is a dentist. They hold a small bright mirror. They work in the chair room. They check our teeth.
pages.chinese: 这是一位牙医。他们拿着一个小亮镜。他们在诊室里工作。他们检查我们的牙。

pages.english: This is a doctor. They wear a white coat. They work in the clinic. They help us feel better.
pages.chinese: 这是一位医生。他们穿着白大褂。他们在诊室工作。他们帮我们好起来。

pages.english: This is a farmer. They wear a straw hat. They work in the field. They grow our food.
pages.chinese: 这是一位农民。他们戴着草帽。他们在田里干活。他们种我们吃的粮食。

pages.english: This is a firefighter. They wear a heavy red suit. They ride on the truck. They put out fires.
pages.chinese: 这是一位消防员。他们穿着厚重的红色防护服。他们坐在消防车上。他们灭火。

pages.english: This is a teacher. They hold a book in their hand. They stand at the front. They teach us new things.
pages.chinese: 这是一位老师。他们手里拿着书。他们站在前面。他们教我们新东西。

pages.english: This is a police officer. They wear a blue uniform. They stand on the street. They keep us safe.
pages.chinese: 这是一位警察。他们穿着蓝色制服。他们站在街上。他们保护我们的安全。
